  --YDZD.SERIES AS VISIT_TIMES,--住院次数

 nvl(p.COMPANY_CERTIFICATE_NO,'-')  AS sfzhm,--身份证件号码（病人基本信息）
TRUNC(months_between(admission_time, birth_date)/12)  AS nl,--年龄（岁）（病人基本信息）

  '-' as bfmc,

'-'GMSBZ,--过敏史标志
'-'GMS,--过敏史

(case when p.physi_sex_name='男' then '1' else '2' end) as XBDM,--性别代码
p.physi_sex_name as XBMC  , --性别



 nvl((SELECT  case when regexp_replace(A.STRING_VALUE,'\d','') is not null then '0' else replace(A.STRING_VALUE,' ','') end   from mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00009' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'-') as JBZDDM  , --疾病诊断编码

 nvl((SELECT case when regexp_replace(A.STRING_VALUE,'\d','') is not null then '0' else replace(A.STRING_VALUE,' ','') end  from mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00009' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'-') as JBZDMC, --疾病诊断编码

 nvl((SELECT TO_CHAR(nvl(A.vitalsign_nval1,'0') ,'FM9999990.00')   FROM mcs_vital_info A
 WHERE A.vitalsign_type='1014' and a.is_valid='1' AND A.PATIENT_UID=f.PATIENT_UID
   and rownum=1),'0')  as  TZ  , ----体重（kg）

 nvl((SELECT case when regexp_replace(A.STRING_VALUE,'\d','') is not null then '0' else replace(A.STRING_VALUE,' ','') end   from mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00027' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'0') as SSY  , ----收缩压（mmHg）

nvl((SELECT case when regexp_replace(A.STRING_VALUE,'\d','') is not null then '0' else replace(A.STRING_VALUE,' ','') end   from mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00028' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'0')  as  SZY  , ----舒张压（mmHg）

TO_CHAR(
nvl((SELECT case when regexp_replace(A.STRING_VALUE,'\d','') is not null and  regexp_replace(A.STRING_VALUE,'\d','')<>'.'  then '0'
 when A.STRING_VALUE='.'  then '0'
else   replace(A.STRING_VALUE,' ','')   end   from mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00022' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'0')
 ,'FM9999990.0')
 as TW  , ----体温（℃）

nvl((SELECT case when regexp_replace(A.STRING_VALUE,'\d','') is not null then '0' else replace(A.STRING_VALUE,' ','') end   from mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00023' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'0')  as  ML  , ----脉率（次/min）

nvl((SELECT case when regexp_replace(A.STRING_VALUE,'\d','') is not null then '0' else replace(A.STRING_VALUE,' ','') end  from mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00023' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'0')  as  XL  , ----心率（次/min）

 nvl((SELECT case when regexp_replace(A.STRING_VALUE,'\d','') is not null then '0' else replace(A.STRING_VALUE,' ','') end   from mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00024' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'0')  as HX  , ----呼吸频率（次/min）

 nvl((SELECT case when regexp_replace(A.STRING_VALUE,'\d','') is not null then '0' else replace(A.STRING_VALUE,' ','') end  from mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00127' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1) ,'0') as  XTJCZ  , ----血糖检测值（mmol/L）
'基础护理' as  HLLXDM  , ----护理类型----护理类型
'1' as HLDJDM  , --护理等级代码

'一级护理'  HLLXMC,--护理类型名称

'一级护理'HLDJMC,--护理等级名称
'-' as YSQKDM  , ----饮食情况代码
'-' as HXJJHXM  , --呼吸机监护项目


'1'YSQKMC,--饮食情况名称
'1'SFYHLGCJL,--是否有护理观察记录
'1'SFYHLCZJL,--是否有护理操作记录
'1'SFYSMTZJCJL,--是否有生命体征监测记录

nvl((SELECT A.STRING_VALUE  from mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00150' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'-')   as HLGCXMMC  , ----护理观察项目名称

nvl((SELECT to_char(A.NUMBER_VALUE) from mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00151' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1),'-')  as HLGCJG  , ----护理观察结果

 nvl((SELECt A.STRING_VALUE  from mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00171' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1) ,'-')  as NURSING_OPER_NAME, ----护理操作名称

 nvl((SELECT A.STRING_VALUE  from mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00148' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1) ,'-') as HLCZXMLMMC  , ----护理操作项目类目名称

nvl(to_char((SELECT A.NUMBER_VALUE from mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00149' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1)) ,
(SELECT nvl(A.STRING_VALUE,'-')  from mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=f.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00153' and A.FORM_ID=f.ID AND ROWNUM=1)) as HLCZJG   ,----护理操作结果

f.created_name  as  HSQM ,-- 护士签名
f.created_by  as  HSGH ,-- 护士工号

'1' as  XGBZ ,-- 修改标志
'0' as  MJ ,-- 密级

  WHEN（SELECT A.Number_Value from mcs_doc_form_records a where A.FORM_ID=WSFL.ID  and a.node_code='00034' and a.patient_uid=WSFL.Patient_Uid and rownum=1）is not null then '侧切'
  WHEN（SELECT A.Number_Value from mcs_doc_form_records a where  A.FORM_ID=WSFL.ID and a.node_code='00036' and a.patient_uid=WSFL.Patient_Uid and rownum=1）is not null then '皮外缝合°'
  WHEN（SELECT A.Number_Value from mcs_doc_form_records a where A.FORM_ID=WSFL.ID and a.node_code='00037' and a.patient_uid=WSFL.Patient_Uid and rownum=1）is not null then '皮内缝合°'

   else  '-'  END)

    AS HYQK  ,--会阴情况（分娩记录单中会阴或阴道血肿处理、子宫颈裂伤处理做合并处理）

  nvl((SELECT A.STRING_VALUE from mcs_doc_form_records a where
    a.template_code=WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE and
     a.node_code='00085' and
      A.FORM_ID=WSFL.ID and rownum=1)   ,'-') AS  XBSSGC  ,--修补手术过程（无）

  nvl((SELECT A.STRING_VALUE from mcs_doc_form_records a where
    a.template_code=WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE and
     a.node_code='00126' and
      A.FORM_ID=WSFL.ID and rownum=1)

  nvl((SELECT nvl(to_date(A.STRING_VALUE,'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:mi:ss') ,to_date（'1900-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) from mcs_doc_form_records a where
    a.template_code=WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE and

'0'  AS  CHJCSJ  ,--产后检查时间（min）

nvl((SELECT case when regexp_replace(A.STRING_VALUE,'\d','') is not null then '0' else replace(A.STRING_VALUE,' ','') end from mcs_doc_form_records a where
    a.template_code=WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE and
     a.node_code='00040' and
      A.FORM_ID=WSFL.ID and rownum=1) ,'0') AS  CHSSY  ,--产后收缩压（mmHg ）--产后2小时观察表中收缩压

nvl((SELECT case when regexp_replace(A.STRING_VALUE,'\d','') is not null then '0' else replace(A.STRING_VALUE,' ','') end from mcs_doc_form_records a where
    a.template_code=WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE and
     a.node_code='00041' and
      A.FORM_ID=WSFL.ID and rownum=1) ,'0') AS  CHSZY  ,--产后舒张压（mmHg ）--产后2小时观察表中舒张压

'0'AS CHMBC  ,--产后脉搏（次/min ）--产后2小时观察表中心率

'0' AS CHXLC  ,--产后心率（次/min ）--产后2小时观察表中心率

nvl((SELECT case when regexp_replace(A.STRING_VALUE,'\d','') is not null then '0' else replace(A.STRING_VALUE,' ','') end from mcs_doc_form_records a where
    a.template_code=WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE and
     a.node_code='00039' and
      A.FORM_ID=WSFL.ID and rownum=1) ,'0') AS  CHCXL  ,--产后出血量（mL）--分娩记录单中失血量

   '-' AS CHGS  ,--产后宫缩--无

'0' AS CHGDGD  ,--产后宫底高度（cm）--产妇产后2小时观察表中宫底

'-' AS GC  ,--肛查--产妇产后2小时观察表中肛查


 nvl((CASE
  WHEN（SELECT A.Number_Value from mcs_doc_form_records a where A.FORM_ID=WSFL.ID and a.node_code='00062'  and rownum=1）is not null then '1'

   else  '2'  END),'-') AS  XSEXBDM  ,--新生儿性别代码--新生儿出生记录中胎儿性别
    nvl((CASE
  WHEN（SELECT A.Number_Value from mcs_doc_form_records a where A.FORM_ID=WSFL.ID and a.node_code='00062'  and rownum=1）is not null then '男'

  nvl((SELECT  case when regexp_replace(A.STRING_VALUE,'\d','') is not null then '0' else replace(A.STRING_VALUE,' ','') end
   from mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00065' and A.FORM_ID=WSFL.ID  and rownum=1)
   ,'0') AS  XSECSTZ  ,--新生儿出生体重（g）
  nvl((SELECT case when regexp_replace(A.STRING_VALUE,'\d','') is not null then '0' else replace(A.STRING_VALUE,' ','') end from mcs_doc_form_records a where a.template_code=WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE and a.node_code='00064' and A.FORM_ID=WSFL.ID and rownum=1)
  ,'0') AS  XSECSSC  ,--新生儿出生身长（cm）

 '0' AS CLDX  ,--产瘤大小--新生儿出生记录中产瘤大小
'-'  AS CLBW  ,--产瘤部位新生儿出生记录中产瘤部位
  '10' AS APGARPFJGSJDM  ,--Apgar评分间隔时间代码  --无

nvl((SELECT A.STRING_VALUE from mcs_doc_form_records a where
    a.template_code=WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE and

SELECT
       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(f.ID), 1, 100) AS ID, -- 内码，是，唯一主键

       '49557032X' AS ORG_CODE, -- 组织机构代码，是
       '山东省第二人民医院' AS ORG_NAME, -- 组织机构名称，是

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(YDZD.mrn ||'|'|| YDZD.series), 1, 50) AS ADMISSION_ID, -- 住院唯一标示号，是；沿用原 ZYLSH 口径

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(dept.qmpt_code), 1, 20) AS DEPT_CODE, -- 科室代码
       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(dept.qmpt_name), 1, 50) AS DEPT_NAME, -- 科室名称，是
       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(YDZD.WARD_NAME), 1, 50) AS WARD_NAME, -- 病区名称

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS EORD_NUM, -- 病房号；原 SQL 固定 '-'，无可靠病房号来源，暂不硬填
       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(YDZD.Bed_No), 1, 10) AS SICKBED_NUM, -- 病床号

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(YDZD.NAME), 1, 50) AS NAME, -- 患者姓名，是

       CASE
           WHEN YDZD.physi_sex_name LIKE '男%' THEN '1'
           WHEN YDZD.physi_sex_name LIKE '女%' THEN '2'
           WHEN YDZD.physi_sex_name IS NULL THEN '0'
           ELSE '9'
       END AS SEX_CODE, -- 性别代码，是

       SUBSTRB(
           CASE
               WHEN YDZD.physi_sex_name LIKE '男%' THEN '男'
               WHEN YDZD.physi_sex_name LIKE '女%' THEN '女'
               WHEN YDZD.physi_sex_name IS NULL THEN '未知'
               ELSE TO_CHAR(YDZD.physi_sex_name)
           END,
           1,
           50
       ) AS SEX_NAME, -- 性别名称，是

       CASE
           WHEN YDZD.admission_time IS NOT NULL AND YDZD.birth_date IS NOT NULL
           THEN LEAST(200, GREATEST(0, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(YDZD.admission_time, YDZD.birth_date) / 12)))
           ELSE 0
       END AS AGE, -- 年龄（岁），是

       CASE
           WHEN YDZD.admission_time IS NOT NULL
                AND YDZD.birth_date IS NOT NULL
                AND TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(YDZD.admission_time, YDZD.birth_date) / 12) = 0
           THEN SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(GREATEST(0, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(YDZD.admission_time, YDZD.birth_date)))), 1, 8)
           ELSE NULL
       END AS AGE_MONTH, -- 年龄（月）

       SUBSTRB(
           (SELECT a.assess_value
              FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
             WHERE a.assess_code = 'Z01028'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           1,
           20
       ) AS ADMISSION_TYPE, -- 入病房方式

       diag_dict.std_code  AS ADMISSION_DIAGNOSIS_CD, -- 入院诊断编码；需要确认移动护理库 ICD 字段，暂不硬编

       diag_dict.std_name AS ADMISSION_DIAGNOSIS_NA, -- 入院诊断描述，是

       TO_CHAR(p.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS ADMISSION_DATE, -- 入院日期时间，是

       SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_CHAR(YDZD.diagnosis_name), '-'), 1, 1000) AS CHIEF_COMPLAINT, -- 主要症状；原 SQL 使用 diagnosis_name，先沿用

       NVL(
           (SELECT ROUND(TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.assess_value, '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')), 2)
              FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
             WHERE a.assess_code = 'K02006.n'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS WEIGHT, -- 体重（kg），是

       NVL(
           (SELECT ROUND(TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.assess_value, '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')))
              FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
             WHERE a.assess_code = 'K01010'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS BREATHING_RATE, -- 呼吸频率（次/min），是

       NVL(
           (SELECT ROUND(TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.assess_value, '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')))
              FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
             WHERE a.assess_code = 'K01009'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS PULSE_RATE, -- 脉率（次/min），是

       NVL(
           (SELECT ROUND(TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.assess_value, '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')))
              FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
             WHERE a.assess_code = 'K01011'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS PRESSURE_H, -- 收缩压（mmHg），是

       NVL(
           (SELECT ROUND(TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.assess_value, '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')))
              FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
             WHERE a.assess_code = 'K01012'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS PRESSURE_L, -- 舒张压（mmHg），是

       SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_CHAR(YDZD.diagnosis_name), '-'), 1, 1000) AS ADMISSION_CAUSE, -- 入院原因

           CASE
           WHEN (SELECT a.assess_value
                   FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
                  WHERE a.assess_code = 'Z01026'
                    AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                    AND ROWNUM = 1) = '门诊'
           THEN '1'
           WHEN (SELECT a.assess_value
                   FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
                  WHERE a.assess_code = 'Z01026'
                    AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                    AND ROWNUM = 1) = '急诊'
           THEN '2'
           WHEN (SELECT a.assess_value
                   FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
                  WHERE a.assess_code = 'Z01026'
                    AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                    AND ROWNUM = 1) = '转入'
           THEN '3'
           ELSE '9'
       END AS ADMISSION_TYPE_CODE,

       CASE
           WHEN (SELECT a.assess_value
                   FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
                  WHERE a.assess_code = 'Z01026'
                    AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                    AND ROWNUM = 1) = '门诊'
           THEN '门诊'
           WHEN (SELECT a.assess_value
                   FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
                  WHERE a.assess_code = 'Z01026'
                    AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                    AND ROWNUM = 1) = '急诊'
           THEN '急诊'
           WHEN (SELECT a.assess_value
                   FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
                  WHERE a.assess_code = 'Z01026'
                    AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                    AND ROWNUM = 1) = '转入'
           THEN '其他医疗机构转入'
           ELSE '其他'
       END AS ADMISSION_TYPE_NAME,

       CAST(0 AS NUMBER) AS APGAR, -- Apgar评分值；原 SQL 固定 0

       NVL(
           (SELECT CASE
                       WHEN a.assess_code_type LIKE '%.1' OR a.assess_value LIKE '1.%' OR a.assess_value = '良好' THEN '1'
                       WHEN a.assess_code_type LIKE '%.2' OR a.assess_value LIKE '2.%' OR a.assess_value = '一般' THEN '2'
                       WHEN a.assess_code_type LIKE '%.3' OR a.assess_value LIKE '3.%' OR a.assess_value = '较差' THEN '3'
                       ELSE '9'
                   END
              FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
             WHERE a.assess_code = 'J01018'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           '1'
       ) AS DIET_CODE, -- 饮食情况代码，是

       NVL(
           (SELECT SUBSTRB(
                       CASE
                           WHEN a.assess_code_type LIKE '%.1' OR a.assess_value LIKE '1.%' OR a.assess_value = '良好' THEN '良好'
                           WHEN a.assess_code_type LIKE '%.2' OR a.assess_value LIKE '2.%' OR a.assess_value = '一般' THEN '一般'
                           WHEN a.assess_code_type LIKE '%.3' OR a.assess_value LIKE '3.%' OR a.assess_value = '较差' THEN '较差'
                           WHEN INSTR(a.assess_value, '.') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(a.assess_value, INSTR(a.assess_value, '.', -1) + 1)
                           ELSE a.assess_value
                       END,
                       1,
                       50
                   )
              FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
             WHERE a.assess_code = 'J01018'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           '良好'
       ) AS DIET_NAME, -- 饮食情况描述，是

       CAST(NULL AS CHAR(1)) AS DEVELOPMENT_CODE, -- 发育程度代码；原 SQL 无可靠来源
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS DEVELOPMENT_NAME, -- 发育程度描述；原 SQL 无可靠来源
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR(1)) AS SPIRIT_CODE, -- 精神状态正常标志；原 SQL 无可靠标准来源
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1000)) AS SLEEP_CODE, -- 睡眠状况；原 SQL 无可靠来源
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1000)) AS SPECIAL_CASE, -- 特殊情况；原 SQL 无可靠来源
       CAST(NULL AS CHAR(1)) AS PHYCHOLOGICAL_CD, -- 心理状态代码；原 SQL 无可靠来源
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS PHYCHOLOGICAL_NA, -- 心理状态描述；原 SQL 无可靠来源
        NVL(
           (SELECT CASE
                       WHEN TRIM(a.assess_value) IN ('营养摄入良好', '良好') THEN '1'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.assess_value) IN ('营养摄入适当', '适当') THEN '2'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.assess_value) IN ('营养摄入不足', '不足', '非常差') THEN '3'
                       ELSE NULL
                   END
              FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
             WHERE a.assess_code IN ('J02001', 'J02001.1', 'J02001.2', 'J02001.3', 'J02001.4')
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           '2'
       ) AS NUTRITION_CODE, -- 营养状态代码

       NVL(
           (SELECT CASE
                       WHEN TRIM(a.assess_value) IN ('营养摄入良好', '良好') THEN '良好'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.assess_value) IN ('营养摄入适当', '适当') THEN '中等'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.assess_value) IN ('营养摄入不足', '不足', '非常差') THEN '差'
                       ELSE NULL
                   END
              FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
             WHERE a.assess_code IN ('J02001', 'J02001.1', 'J02001.2', 'J02001.3', 'J02001.4')
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           '中等'
       ) AS NUTRITION_NAME, -- 营养状态描述

       NVL(
           (SELECT CASE
                       WHEN TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(aa.total_score, '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')) = 100 THEN '1'
                       WHEN TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(aa.total_score, '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')) > 60
                            AND TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(aa.total_score, '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')) < 100 THEN '2'
                       WHEN TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(aa.total_score, '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')) <= 60 THEN '3'
                       ELSE '1'
                   END
              FROM mcs_doc_form aa
             WHERE aa.assess_form_id = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           '1'
       ) AS SELF_CARE_ABILITY, -- 自理能力代码，是

       NVL(
           (SELECT CASE
                       WHEN TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(aa.total_score, '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')) = 100 THEN '完全自理'
                       WHEN TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(aa.total_score, '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')) > 60
                            AND TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(aa.total_score, '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')) < 100 THEN '部分自理'
                       WHEN TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(aa.total_score, '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')) <= 60 THEN '不能自理'
                       ELSE '完全自理'
                   END
              FROM mcs_doc_form aa
             WHERE aa.assess_form_id = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           '完全自理'
       ) AS SELF_CARE_ABI_NA, -- 自理能力描述

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               (SELECT a.assess_value
                  FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
                 WHERE a.assess_code = 'Z04031'
                   AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                   AND ROWNUM = 1),
               '无'
           ),
           1,
           1000
       ) AS ALLERGY_HISTORY_FIR, -- 过敏史

       CASE
           WHEN NVL(
                    (SELECT a.assess_value
                       FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
                      WHERE a.assess_code = 'Z04002'
                        AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                        AND ROWNUM = 1),
                    '无'
                ) IN ('无', '否', '没有', '无特殊')
           THEN '1'
           ELSE '0'
       END AS HEALTH_STATUS_CODE, -- 一般健康状况标志；1是、0否

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               (SELECT a.assess_value
                  FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
                 WHERE a.assess_code = 'Z04002'
                   AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                   AND ROWNUM = 1),
               '无'
           ),
           1,
           1000
       ) AS DISEASE_HIS, -- 疾病史（含外伤）

       '0' AS INFECTION_FLAG, -- 患者传染性标志；原 SQL 固定为否，按标准改为 0

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1000)) AS INFECTION_HISTORY, -- 传染病史；原 SQL 无可靠来源
       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1000)) AS VACCINATION_HISTORY, -- 预防接种史；原 SQL 无可靠来源

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               (SELECT a.assess_value
                  FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
                 WHERE a.assess_code = 'Z04015'
                   AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                   AND ROWNUM = 1),
               '无'
           ),
           1,
           1000
       ) AS SURGERY_HISTORY, -- 手术史

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               (SELECT a.assess_value
                  FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
                 WHERE a.assess_code = 'Z04021'
                   AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                   AND ROWNUM = 1),
               '无'
           ),
           1,
           1000
       ) AS BT_HISTORY, -- 输血史

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               (SELECT a.assess_value
                  FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
                 WHERE a.assess_code = 'Z04031'
                   AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                   AND ROWNUM = 1),
               '无'
           ),
           1,
           1000
       ) AS ALLERGY_HISTORY_SEN, -- 过敏史

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               (SELECT a.assess_value
                  FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
                 WHERE a.assess_code = 'Z06005'
                   AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                   AND ROWNUM = 1),
               '无'
           ),
           1,
           1000
       ) AS FAMILY_HISTORY, -- 家族史

       CASE
           WHEN (SELECT a.assess_value
                   FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
                  WHERE a.assess_code = 'Z05014'
                    AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                    AND ROWNUM = 1) = '是'
           THEN '1'
           ELSE '0'
       END AS SMOKE_STATUS, -- 吸烟标志；标准为 1是、0否

       NVL(
           (SELECT ROUND(TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.assess_value, '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')) * 365)
              FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
             WHERE a.assess_code = 'Z05019'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS STOP_SMOKE_DAY, -- 停止吸烟天数

       NVL(
           (SELECT CASE
                       WHEN (SELECT b.assess_value
                               FROM mcs_assess_form_record b
                              WHERE b.assess_code = 'Z05014'
                                AND b.FORM_ID = f.ID
                                AND ROWNUM = 1) = '是'
                            AND NVL((SELECT c.assess_value
                                       FROM mcs_assess_form_record c
                                      WHERE c.assess_code = 'Z05018'
                                        AND c.FORM_ID = f.ID
                                        AND ROWNUM = 1), '否') = '否'
                       THEN '3'
                       WHEN (SELECT d.assess_value
                               FROM mcs_assess_form_record d
                              WHERE d.assess_code = 'Z05018'
                                AND d.FORM_ID = f.ID
                                AND ROWNUM = 1) = '是'
                       THEN '2'
                       ELSE '1'
                   END
              FROM dual),
           '1'
       ) AS SMOKE_STATUS_CODE, -- 吸烟状况代码

       NVL(
           (SELECT CASE
                       WHEN (SELECT b.assess_value
                               FROM mcs_assess_form_record b
                              WHERE b.assess_code = 'Z05014'
                                AND b.FORM_ID = f.ID
                                AND ROWNUM = 1) = '是'
                            AND NVL((SELECT c.assess_value
                                       FROM mcs_assess_form_record c
                                      WHERE c.assess_code = 'Z05018'
                                        AND c.FORM_ID = f.ID
                                        AND ROWNUM = 1), '否') = '否'
                       THEN '吸烟'
                       WHEN (SELECT d.assess_value
                               FROM mcs_assess_form_record d
                              WHERE d.assess_code = 'Z05018'
                                AND d.FORM_ID = f.ID
                                AND ROWNUM = 1) = '是'
                       THEN '过去吸，已戒烟'
                       ELSE '从不吸烟'
                   END
              FROM dual),
           '从不吸烟'
       ) AS SMOKE_STATUS_NAME, -- 吸烟状况描述

       NVL(
           (SELECT ROUND(TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.assess_value, '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')))
              FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
             WHERE a.assess_code = 'Z05017'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS SMOKE_COUNT_DAY, -- 日吸烟量（支）

       CASE
           WHEN (SELECT a.assess_code_type
                   FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
                  WHERE a.assess_code = 'Z05023'
                    AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                    AND ROWNUM = 1) IN ('Z05023.1', 'Z05023.2', 'Z05023.3')
           THEN '1'
           ELSE '0'
       END AS DRINK_STATUS, -- 饮酒标志；原 SQL 用了吸烟字段，这里按饮酒频率字段判断

            NVL(
           (SELECT CASE
                       WHEN a.assess_value IN ('从不', '否', '不饮酒') THEN '1'
                       WHEN a.assess_value IN ('偶尔') THEN '2'
                       WHEN a.assess_value IN ('每周不到一次', '每周不到1次') THEN '22'
                       WHEN a.assess_value IN ('1d/月-3d/月', '1天/月-3天/月', '1d/月～3d/月') THEN '21'
                       WHEN a.assess_value IN ('每周1-2次', '每周1－2次', '每周1～2次') THEN '33'
                       WHEN a.assess_value IN ('每周至少3次') THEN '32'
                       WHEN a.assess_value IN ('每周5-6次', '每周5－6次', '每周5～6次') THEN '31'
                       WHEN a.assess_value IN ('每天') THEN '4'
                       WHEN a.assess_value IN ('经常') THEN '3'
                       ELSE '1'
                   END
              FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
             WHERE a.assess_code = 'Z05023'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           '1'
       ) AS DRINK_FREQUENCY,

       NVL(
           (SELECT CASE
                       WHEN a.assess_value IN ('从不', '否', '不饮酒') THEN '从不'
                       WHEN a.assess_value IN ('偶尔') THEN '偶尔'
                       WHEN a.assess_value IN ('每周不到一次', '每周不到1次') THEN '少于1d/月'
                       WHEN a.assess_value IN ('1d/月-3d/月', '1天/月-3天/月', '1d/月～3d/月') THEN '1d/月-3d/月'
                       WHEN a.assess_value IN ('每周1-2次', '每周1－2次', '每周1～2次') THEN '1d/周-2d/周'
                       WHEN a.assess_value IN ('每周至少3次') THEN '3d/周-4d/周'
                       WHEN a.assess_value IN ('每周5-6次', '每周5－6次', '每周5～6次') THEN '5d/周-6d/周'
                       WHEN a.assess_value IN ('每天') THEN '每天'
                       WHEN a.assess_value IN ('经常') THEN '经常'
                       ELSE '从不'
                   END
              FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
             WHERE a.assess_code = 'Z05023'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           '从不'
       ) AS DRINK_NAME,

       NVL(
           (SELECT ROUND(TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.assess_value, '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')))
              FROM mcs_assess_form_record a
             WHERE a.assess_code = 'Z05024'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS DRINK_AMOUNT, -- 日饮酒量（mL）

       '1' AS NOTICE_DOC_CODE, -- 通知医师标志，是

       TO_CHAR(YDZD.admission_ward_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS NOTICE_DOC_DATE, -- 通知医师日期时间，是

       TO_CHAR(f.assess_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS ASSESSMENT_DATE, -- 评估日期时间，是

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(f.created_name), 1, 50) AS RES_NURSE_NAME, -- 责任护士签名，是
       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(f.created_name), 1, 50) AS ACCEPTS_NURS_NAME, -- 接诊护士签名，是

       TO_CHAR(f.assess_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS SIGNATURE_DATE, -- 签名日期时间，是

       '370104' AS DISTRICT_CODE, -- 行政区划，是
       'ADDHIS' AS EXCHANGE_TYPE, -- 交换类型，是
       TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS SYSTEM_TIME -- 数据上传时间，是

  FROM mcs_assess_form f
       JOIN inpatients YDZD
         ON f.PATIENT_UID = YDZD.pat_index_no
                   LEFT JOIN pat_visit@HIS p
       ON p.PATIENT_ID = SUBSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID, 1, INSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID, '_') - 1)
      AND p.VISIT_ID = YDZD.SERIES
           LEFT JOIN DIAGNOSIS_BASY dg
       ON dg.PATIENT_ID = SUBSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID, 1, INSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID, '_') - 1)
      AND dg.VISIT_ID = YDZD.SERIES
        left join (
        select trim(to_char(院标编码)) as local_code,
               max(nullif(trim(to_char(国标编码)), '')) as std_code,
               max(nullif(trim(to_char(国标名称)), '')) as std_name
          from cda_dictionary@sjzx
         where 字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
           and 系统标识 = 'HIS'
           and trim(to_char(院标编码)) is not null
         group by trim(to_char(院标编码))
       ) diag_dict
       on diag_dict.local_code = trim(to_char(dg.diagnosis_code))
       left join dept_dict@his dept on dept.dept_code=YDZD.dept_code

 WHERE f.generator_type = 'manul'
   AND f.is_valid = '1'
   AND YDZD.admission_ward_time IS NOT NULL
    and dg.diagnosis_type = '3'
         and dg.diagnosis_no = '1'
  and p.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  to_date('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

SELECT
       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(WSFL.ID), 1, 100) AS ID, -- 内码，是，唯一主键

       '49557032X' AS ORG_CODE, -- 组织机构代码，是
       '山东省第二人民医院' AS ORG_NAME, -- 组织机构名称，是

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(YDZD.mrn || '|' || YDZD.series), 1, 50) AS ADMISSION_ID, -- 住院唯一标示号，是

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(YDZD.NAME), 1, 50) AS NAME, -- 产妇姓名，是

       CASE
           WHEN YDZD.admission_time IS NOT NULL AND YDZD.birth_date IS NOT NULL
           THEN LEAST(200, GREATEST(0, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(YDZD.admission_time, YDZD.birth_date) / 12)))
           ELSE 0
       END AS AGE, -- 年龄（岁），是

       SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_CHAR(dept.qmpt_code), TO_CHAR(YDZD.dept_code)), 1, 20) AS DEPT_CODE, -- 科室代码

       SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_CHAR(dept.qmpt_name), TO_CHAR(YDZD.dept_name)), 1, 50) AS DEPT_NAME, -- 科室名称，是

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(YDZD.WARD_NAME), 1, 50) AS WARD_NAME, -- 病区名称

           WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mcs_doc_form_records a WHERE a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID AND a.node_code = '00031' AND a.NUMBER_VALUE IS NOT NULL) > 0 THEN '5'
           ELSE '1'
       END AS LACERATE_DEGREE_CODE, -- 会阴裂伤情况代码，是；需确认平台是否接受0无裂伤

       SUBSTRB(
           CASE
               WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mcs_doc_form_records a WHERE a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID AND a.node_code = '00028' AND a.NUMBER_VALUE IS NOT NULL) > 0 THEN 'I°裂伤'
               WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mcs_doc_form_records a WHERE a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID AND a.node_code = '00029' AND a.NUMBER_VALUE IS NOT NULL) > 0 THEN 'Ⅱ°裂伤'
               WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mcs_doc_form_records a WHERE a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID AND a.node_code = '00030' AND a.NUMBER_VALUE IS NOT NULL) > 0 THEN 'Ⅲ°裂伤'
               WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mcs_doc_form_records a WHERE a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID AND a.node_code = '00031' AND a.NUMBER_VALUE IS NOT NULL) > 0 THEN '会阴切开'
               ELSE '无裂伤'
           END,
           1,
           50
       ) AS LACERATE_DEGREE, -- 会阴裂伤情况，是

       '0' AS HEMATOMA_CODE, -- 会阴血肿标志，是；旧 SQL 固定无，按标准改为0

             NVL(
           (SELECT CASE
                       /* 复合麻醉：神经阻滞 + 局部浸润/局部麻醉 */
                       WHEN (
                                TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%神经阻滞%'
                             OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%阴部神经%'
                             OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%神经组织%'
                            )
                            AND (
                                TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%局部%'
                             OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%浸润%'
                             OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%经润%'
                             OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%侵润%'
                             OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%浸入%'
                            )
                       THEN '4'

                       /* 单独神经阻滞麻醉 */
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%神经阻滞%'
                         OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%阴部神经%'
                         OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%神经组织%'
                       THEN '33'

                       /* 单独局部浸润麻醉 */
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%局部浸润%'
                         OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%局部经润%'
                         OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%局部侵润%'
                         OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%局部浸入%'
                       THEN '35'

                       /* 单独局部麻醉 */
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%局部麻醉%'
                         OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '局部浸润'
                         OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '局部'
                       THEN '3'

                       /* 原始值本身就是标准代码 */
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) IN ('1','2','3','4','9','11','12','13','21','22',
                                                     '31','32','33','34','35','36','41','42','43','44','45')
                       THEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE)

                       ELSE '9'
                   END
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE
               AND a.node_code = '00044'
               AND a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           '9'
       ) AS ANES_METHOD_CODE, -- 麻醉方法代码：4复合麻醉，33神经阻滞麻醉，35局部浸润麻醉，3局部麻醉，9其他

       NVL(
           (SELECT CASE
                       WHEN (
                                TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%神经阻滞%'
                             OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%阴部神经%'
                             OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%神经组织%'
                            )
                            AND (
                                TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%局部%'
                             OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%浸润%'
                             OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%经润%'
                             OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%侵润%'
                             OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%浸入%'
                            )
                       THEN '复合麻醉'

                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%神经阻滞%'
                         OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%阴部神经%'
                         OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%神经组织%'
                       THEN '神经阻滞麻醉'

                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%局部浸润%'
                         OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%局部经润%'
                         OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%局部侵润%'
                         OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%局部浸入%'
                       THEN '局部浸润麻醉'

                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%局部麻醉%'
                         OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '局部浸润'
                         OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '局部'
                       THEN '局部麻醉'

                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '1'  THEN '全身麻醉'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '2'  THEN '椎管内麻醉'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '3'  THEN '局部麻醉'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '4'  THEN '复合麻醉'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '9'  THEN '其他麻醉方法'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '11' THEN '吸入麻醉'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '12' THEN '静脉麻醉'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '13' THEN '基础麻醉'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '21' THEN '蛛网膜下腔阻滞麻醉'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '22' THEN '硬脊膜外腔阻滞麻醉'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '31' THEN '神经丛阻滞麻醉'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '32' THEN '神经节阻滞麻醉'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '33' THEN '神经阻滞麻醉'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '34' THEN '区域阻滞麻醉'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '35' THEN '局部浸润麻醉'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '36' THEN '表面麻醉'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '41' THEN '静吸复合全麻'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '42' THEN '针药复合麻醉'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '43' THEN '神经丛与硬膜外阻滞复合麻醉'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '44' THEN '全麻复合全身降温'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '45' THEN '全麻复合控制性降压'

                       ELSE '其他麻醉方法'
                   END
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE
               AND a.node_code = '00044'
               AND a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           '其他麻醉方法'
       ) AS ANAESTHESIA_NAME, -- 麻醉方法

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               (SELECT a.STRING_VALUE
                  FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
                 WHERE a.template_code = WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE
                   AND a.node_code = '00044'
                   AND a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID

       '0' AS VAGNIAL_CODE, -- 阴道裂伤标志；旧 SQL无可靠来源，暂按无

       '0' AS HEAMATORA_CODE, -- 阴道血肿标志；旧 SQL固定无，按标准改为0

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS HEAMATORA_SIZE, -- 阴道血肿大小

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200)) AS HEAMATORA_HANDLE, -- 阴道血肿处理

       '0' AS LACERATION_CODE, -- 宫颈裂伤标志，是；旧 SQL无可靠来源，暂按无

       '无' AS SUTURE_NOTE, -- 宫颈缝合情况，是

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS ANUS_CHECK, -- 肛查

       SUBSTRB(
           (SELECT a.STRING_VALUE

       SUBSTRB(

       SUBSTRB(

       ) AS CONTRACTION_NOTE, -- 宫缩情况

       SUBSTRB(
           (SELECT a.STRING_VALUE

               AND a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           1,
           100
       ) AS UTERUS_RESULT, -- 子宫情况

       SUBSTRB(
           (SELECT a.STRING_VALUE
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a

               AND a.node_code = '00072'
               AND a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           1,
           100
       ) AS LOCHIA_REMARKS, -- 恶露状况

       SUBSTRB(
           (SELECT a.STRING_VALUE

               AND a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           1,
           100
       ) AS REPAIR_OPERA, -- 修补手术过程

       CASE
           WHEN (SELECT a.STRING_VALUE
                   FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
                  WHERE a.template_code = WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE
                    AND a.node_code = '00126'
                    AND a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID
                    AND ROWNUM = 1) LIKE '%是%'
           THEN '1'
           ELSE '0'
       END AS SAVE_BLOOD_CODE, -- 存脐带血情况标志

       SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_CHAR(YDZD.diagnosis), NVL(TO_CHAR(YDZD.diagnosis_name), '-')), 1, 200) AS AFTER_OPER_DIAGNOSIS, -- 产后诊断，是

       TO_CHAR(
           (SELECT TO_DATE(a.STRING_VALUE, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE
               AND a.node_code = '00090'
               AND a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID
               AND REGEXP_LIKE(a.STRING_VALUE, '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}')
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'
       ) AS ALTER_OBS_DATE, -- 产后观察日期时间

       CAST(0 AS NUMBER(3)) AS CHECK_TIME, -- 产后检查时间（min）

       NVL(
           (SELECT TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]+'))
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE
               AND a.node_code = '00040'
               AND a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID
               AND REGEXP_LIKE(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]')
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS SYSTOLIC_PRESSURE, -- 产后收缩压

       NVL(
           (SELECT TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]+'))
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE
               AND a.node_code = '00041'
               AND a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID
               AND REGEXP_LIKE(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]')
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS DIASTOLIC_PRESSURE, -- 产后舒张压

       CAST(0 AS NUMBER(3)) AS PULSE_RATE, -- 产后脉搏；旧 SQL无可靠来源

       CAST(999 AS NUMBER(3)) AS HEART_RATE, -- 产后心率，是；旧 SQL无可靠来源，暂为0

       NVL(
           (SELECT TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]+'))
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE
               AND a.node_code = '00039'
               AND a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID
               AND REGEXP_LIKE(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]')
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS OUT_BLOOD_ML, -- 产后出血量（mL）

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(200)) AS AFTER_CONTRACTION, -- 产后宫缩

       CAST(0 AS NUMBER(4,1)) AS HAREM_HEIGHT, -- 产后宫底高度

       '0' AS BLADDER_CODE, -- 产后膀胱充盈标志；无可靠来源，暂按否

       CASE
           WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*)
                   FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
                  WHERE a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID
                    AND a.node_code = '00062'
                    AND a.NUMBER_VALUE IS NOT NULL) > 0
           THEN '1'
           ELSE '2'
       END AS CHILD_SEX_CODE, -- 新生儿性别代码

       CASE
           WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*)
                   FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
                  WHERE a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID
                    AND a.node_code = '00062'
                    AND a.NUMBER_VALUE IS NOT NULL) > 0
           THEN '男'
           ELSE '女'
       END AS SEX_NAME, -- 新生儿性别名称，是

       NVL(
           (SELECT TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]+'))
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE
               AND a.node_code = '00065'
               AND a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID
               AND REGEXP_LIKE(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]')
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS NEWBORN_HEAVY, -- 新生儿出生体重（g）

       NVL(
           (SELECT TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?'))
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE
               AND a.node_code = '00064'
               AND a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID
               AND REGEXP_LIKE(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]')
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS NEWBORN_LONG, -- 新生儿出生身长（cm）

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS TUMOR_SIZE, -- 产瘤大小

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS TUMOR_PART, -- 产瘤部位

       '3' AS APGAR, -- Apgar评分间隔时间代码：3代表10min

       CAST(10 AS NUMBER(3)) AS APGAR_TIME, -- Apgar评分间隔时间

       NVL(
           (SELECT TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]+'))
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE
               AND a.node_code = '00078'
               AND a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID
               AND REGEXP_LIKE(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]')
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS APGAR_SCORE, -- Apgar评分值

       CASE
           WHEN (SELECT a.STRING_VALUE
                   FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
                  WHERE a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID
                    AND a.node_code = '00123'
                    AND ROWNUM = 1) = '死胎'
           THEN '2'
           WHEN (SELECT a.STRING_VALUE
                   FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
                  WHERE a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID
                    AND a.node_code = '00123'
                    AND ROWNUM = 1) = '死产'
           THEN '3'
           ELSE '1'
       END AS DELIVERY_OUTCOME_CODE, -- 分娩结局代码，是

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               (SELECT a.STRING_VALUE
                  FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
                 WHERE a.template_code = WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE
                   AND a.node_code = '00123'
                   AND a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID
                   AND ROWNUM = 1),
               '活产'
           ),
           1,
           20
       ) AS DELIVERY_OUTCOME, -- 分娩结局
       NVL(
           (SELECT CASE
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) = '无' THEN '1'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%早产%' THEN '4'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%窒息%' THEN '5'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%低体重%'
                         OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%低出生体重%'
                       THEN '6'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%畸形%' THEN '3'
                       WHEN TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%死亡%' THEN '2'
                       ELSE '9'
                   END
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE
               AND a.node_code = '00124'
               AND a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           '1'
       ) AS CHILD_ADNORMAL_CODE, -- 新生儿异常情况代码：1无 2早期新生儿死亡 3畸形 4早产 5窒息 6低出生体重 9其他

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               (SELECT CASE
                           WHEN INSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '|') > 0
                           THEN SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, 1, INSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '|') - 1)
                           ELSE a.STRING_VALUE
                       END
                  FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
                 WHERE a.template_code = WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE
                   AND a.node_code = '00088'
                   AND a.FORM_ID = WSFL.ID
                   AND ROWNUM = 1),
               NVL(WSFL.Created_Name, WSFL.last_updated_name)
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) AS ACCOUCHE_PERSON_NAME, -- 接生人员签名

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS OPERA_DOC_NAME, -- 手术医生签名；阴道分娩无可靠来源

       SUBSTRB(
           (SELECT CASE
                       WHEN INSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '|') > 0
                       THEN SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, 1, INSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '|') - 1)
                       ELSE a.STRING_VALUE
                   END
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = '742'
               AND a.node_code = '00070'
               AND a.patient_uid = WSFL.Patient_Uid
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           1,
           50
       ) AS PEDIATRICIAN_NAME, -- 儿科医生签名；旧 SQL护婴者

       SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_CHAR(WSFL.created_name), TO_CHAR(WSFL.last_updated_name)), 1, 50) AS RECORD_PERSON_NAME, -- 记录人员签名

       '370104' AS DISTRICT_CODE, -- 行政区划，是

       'ADDHIS' AS EXCHANGE_TYPE, -- 交换类型，是

       TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS SYSTEM_TIME -- 数据上传时间，是

  FROM MCS_DOC_FORM WSFL
       JOIN inpatients YDZD
         ON WSFL.PATIENT_UID = YDZD.PAT_INDEX_NO

       LEFT JOIN dept_dict@his dept
         ON dept.dept_code = YDZD.dept_code

       LEFT JOIN pat_visit@HIS p
         ON p.PATIENT_ID = SUBSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID, 1, INSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID, '_') - 1)
        AND p.VISIT_ID = YDZD.SERIES

       LEFT JOIN DIAGNOSIS@HIS dg
         ON dg.PATIENT_ID = p.PATIENT_ID
        AND dg.VISIT_ID = p.VISIT_ID
        AND dg.diagnosis_type = '3'
        AND dg.diagnosis_no = '1'

       LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT TRIM(TO_CHAR(院标编码)) AS local_code,
                   MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_CHAR(国标编码)), '')) AS std_code,
                   MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_CHAR(国标名称)), '')) AS std_name
              FROM cda_dictionary@sjzx
             WHERE 字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
               AND 系统标识 = 'HIS'
               AND TRIM(TO_CHAR(院标编码)) IS NOT NULL
             GROUP BY TRIM(TO_CHAR(院标编码))
       ) diag_dict
         ON diag_dict.local_code =
            TRIM(
                REPLACE(
                    CASE
                        WHEN INSTR(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), '+') > 0
                        THEN SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), 1, INSTR(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), '+') - 1)
                        ELSE TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code)
                    END,
                    '*',
                    ''
                )
            )

 WHERE WSFL.TEMPLATE_CODE = '746'
   AND WSFL.is_valid = '1'
   AND WSFL.created_by <> 'dba'    AND p.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < TO_DATE('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

SELECT
       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(f.ID), 1, 100) AS ID, -- 内码，是，唯一主键

       '49557032X' AS ORG_CODE, -- 组织机构代码，是
       '山东省第二人民医院' AS ORG_NAME, -- 组织机构名称，是

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(p.mrn || '|' || p.series), 1, 50) AS ADMISSION_ID, -- 住院唯一标示号，是

       SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_CHAR(dept.qmpt_code), TO_CHAR(p.dept_code)), 1, 20) AS DEPT_CODE, -- 科室代码

       SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_CHAR(dept.qmpt_name), TO_CHAR(p.dept_name)), 1, 50) AS DEPT_NAME, -- 科室名称，是

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(p.WARD_NAME), 1, 50) AS WARD_NAME, -- 病区名称

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS EORD_NUM, -- 病房号；无可靠来源，不硬填

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(p.Bed_No), 1, 10) AS SICKBED_NUM, -- 病床号

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(p.NAME), 1, 50) AS NAME, -- 患者姓名，是

       CASE
           WHEN p.physi_sex_name LIKE '男%' THEN '1'
           WHEN p.physi_sex_name LIKE '女%' THEN '2'
           WHEN p.physi_sex_name IS NULL THEN '0'
           ELSE '9'
       END AS SEX_CODE, -- 性别代码，是

       SUBSTRB(
           CASE
               WHEN p.physi_sex_name LIKE '男%' THEN '男'
               WHEN p.physi_sex_name LIKE '女%' THEN '女'
               WHEN p.physi_sex_name IS NULL THEN '未知'
               ELSE TO_CHAR(p.physi_sex_name)
           END,
           1,
           50
       ) AS SEX_NAME, -- 性别名称，是

       CASE
           WHEN p.admission_time IS NOT NULL AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
           THEN LEAST(200, GREATEST(0, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(p.admission_time, p.birth_date) / 12)))
           ELSE 0
       END AS AGE, -- 年龄，是

       CASE
           WHEN p.admission_time IS NOT NULL
                AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
                AND TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(p.admission_time, p.birth_date) / 12) = 0
           THEN GREATEST(0, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(p.admission_time, p.birth_date)))
           ELSE NULL
       END AS AGE_MONTH, -- 年龄（月）

       CASE
           WHEN TO_CHAR(p.nursing_class) = '0' THEN '1'
           WHEN TO_CHAR(p.nursing_class) = '1' THEN '2'
           WHEN TO_CHAR(p.nursing_class) = '2' THEN '3'
           WHEN TO_CHAR(p.nursing_class) IN ('3', '999') THEN '4'
           ELSE '4'
       END AS NURSE_LEVEL_CODE, -- 护理等级代码：1特级护理 2一级护理 3二级护理 4三级护理

       SUBSTRB(
           CASE
               WHEN TO_CHAR(p.nursing_class) = '0' THEN '特级护理'
               WHEN TO_CHAR(p.nursing_class) = '1' THEN '一级护理'
               WHEN TO_CHAR(p.nursing_class) = '2' THEN '二级护理'
               WHEN TO_CHAR(p.nursing_class) IN ('3', '999') THEN '三级护理'
               ELSE '三级护理'
           END,
           1,
           50
       ) AS NURSE_LEVEL_NAME, -- 护理等级名称，是

       CASE
           WHEN TO_CHAR(p.nursing_class) = '0' THEN '2' -- 特级护理 -> 特殊护理
           WHEN TO_CHAR(p.nursing_class) IN ('1', '2', '3', '999') THEN '1' -- 一级/二级/三级 -> 基础护理
           ELSE '9'
       END AS NURSE_TYPE_CODE, -- 护理类型代码：1基础护理 2特殊护理 3辩证施护 9其它

       SUBSTRB(
           CASE
               WHEN TO_CHAR(p.nursing_class) = '0' THEN '特殊护理'
               WHEN TO_CHAR(p.nursing_class) IN ('1', '2', '3', '999') THEN '基础护理'
               ELSE '其它'
           END,
           1,
           50
       ) AS NURSE_TYPE_NAME, -- 护理类型描述

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1000)) AS ALLERGIES, -- 过敏史；原SQL无可靠来源

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               TO_CHAR(diag_dict.std_code),
               REPLACE(
                   CASE
                       WHEN INSTR(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), '+') > 0
                       THEN SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), 1, INSTR(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), '+') - 1)
                       ELSE TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code)
                   END,
                   '*',
                   ''
               )
           ),
           1,
           12
       ) AS DISEASE_CODE, -- 疾病诊断编码

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               TO_CHAR(diag_dict.std_name),
               NVL(
                   TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_desc),
                   NVL(
                       (SELECT a.STRING_VALUE
                          FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
                         WHERE a.template_code = f.TEMPLATE_CODE
                           AND a.node_code = '00009'
                           AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                           AND TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) IS NOT NULL
                           AND ROWNUM = 1),
                       NVL(TO_CHAR(p.diagnosis_name), '-')
                   )
               )
           ),
           1,
           200
       ) AS DISEASE, -- 疾病诊断名称，是

       NVL(
           (SELECT ROUND(a.vitalsign_nval1, 2)
              FROM mcs_vital_info a
             WHERE a.vitalsign_type = '1014'
               AND a.is_valid = '1'
               AND a.PATIENT_UID = f.PATIENT_UID
               AND a.vitalsign_nval1 IS NOT NULL
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS WEIGHT, -- 体重，是

       NVL(
           (SELECT ROUND(TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')), 1)
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = f.TEMPLATE_CODE
               AND a.node_code = '00022'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND REGEXP_LIKE(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]')
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS TEMPERATURE, -- 体温，是

       NVL(
           (SELECT TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]+'))
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = f.TEMPLATE_CODE
               AND a.node_code = '00023'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND REGEXP_LIKE(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]')
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS HEART_RATE, -- 心率，是

       NVL(
           (SELECT TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]+'))
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = f.TEMPLATE_CODE
               AND a.node_code = '00024'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND REGEXP_LIKE(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]')
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS BREATHING_RATE, -- 呼吸频率，是

       NVL(
           (SELECT TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]+'))
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = f.TEMPLATE_CODE
               AND a.node_code = '00027'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND REGEXP_LIKE(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]')
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS PRESSURE_H, -- 收缩压，是

       NVL(
           (SELECT TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]+'))
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = f.TEMPLATE_CODE
               AND a.node_code = '00028'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND REGEXP_LIKE(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]')
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS PRESSURE_L, -- 舒张压，是

       NVL(
           (SELECT ROUND(TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')), 1)
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = f.TEMPLATE_CODE
               AND a.node_code = '00127'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND REGEXP_LIKE(a.STRING_VALUE, '[0-9]')
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS FBG_VALUE, -- 血糖检测值，是

       '1' AS DIET_CODE, -- 饮食情况代码，是；1良好

       '良好' AS DIET_NAME, -- 饮食情况描述，是

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               (SELECT a.STRING_VALUE
                  FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
                 WHERE a.template_code = f.TEMPLATE_CODE
                   AND a.node_code = '00150'
                   AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                   AND TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) IS NOT NULL
                   AND TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) <> '-'
                   AND ROWNUM = 1),
               '病情观察'
           ),
           1,
           30
       ) AS NURSE_OBSERVE_NAME, -- 护理观察项目名称，是

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               (SELECT NVL(TO_CHAR(a.NUMBER_VALUE), a.STRING_VALUE)
                  FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
                 WHERE a.template_code = f.TEMPLATE_CODE
                   AND a.node_code = '00151'
                   AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                   AND (a.NUMBER_VALUE IS NOT NULL OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) IS NOT NULL)
                   AND ROWNUM = 1),
               '未见特殊异常'
           ),
           1,
           1000
       ) AS NURSE_OBSERVE_RESULT, -- 护理观察结果，是

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               (SELECT a.STRING_VALUE
                  FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
                 WHERE a.template_code = f.TEMPLATE_CODE
                   AND a.node_code = '00171'
                   AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                   AND TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) IS NOT NULL
                   AND TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) <> '-'
                   AND ROWNUM = 1),
               '生命体征监测'
           ),
           1,
           100
       ) AS NURSE_PROJECT, -- 护理操作名称，是

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               NVL(
                   (SELECT TO_CHAR(a.NUMBER_VALUE)
                      FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
                     WHERE a.template_code = f.TEMPLATE_CODE
                       AND a.node_code = '00153'
                       AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                       AND a.NUMBER_VALUE IS NOT NULL
                       AND ROWNUM = 1),
                   (SELECT a.STRING_VALUE
                      FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
                     WHERE a.template_code = f.TEMPLATE_CODE
                       AND a.node_code = '00149'
                       AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                       AND TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) IS NOT NULL
                       AND TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) <> '-'
                       AND ROWNUM = 1)
               ),
               '正常'
           ),
           1,
           1000
       ) AS NURSE_PROJECT_RESULT, -- 护理操作结果，是

          SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               (SELECT CASE
                           WHEN a.STRING_VALUE LIKE '%呼吸机%'
                             OR a.STRING_VALUE LIKE '%机械通气%'
                             OR a.STRING_VALUE LIKE '%通气%'
                             OR a.STRING_VALUE LIKE '%氧疗%'
                             OR a.STRING_VALUE LIKE '%吸氧%'
                             OR a.STRING_VALUE LIKE '%高流量%'
                             OR a.STRING_VALUE LIKE '%气管插管%'
                             OR a.STRING_VALUE LIKE '%气管切开%'
                           THEN a.STRING_VALUE
                           ELSE '未使用呼吸机'
                       END
                  FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
                 WHERE a.template_code = f.TEMPLATE_CODE
                   AND a.node_code IN ('00148','00153')
                   AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                   AND TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) IS NOT NULL
                   AND ROWNUM = 1),
               '未使用呼吸机'
           ),
           1,
           1000
       ) AS RM_PROJECT, -- 呼吸机监护项目

       SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_CHAR(f.created_name), TO_CHAR(f.last_updated_name)), 1, 50) AS NURSE_NAME, -- 护士签名，是

       TO_CHAR(f.created_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS RECORD_DATE, -- 签名日期时间，是

       '370104' AS DISTRICT_CODE, -- 行政区划，是

       'ADDHIS' AS EXCHANGE_TYPE, -- 交换类型，是

       TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS SYSTEM_TIME -- 数据上传时间，是

  FROM mcs_doc_form f
       JOIN inpatients p
         ON f.PATIENT_UID = p.pat_index_no

       LEFT JOIN dept_dict@his dept
         ON dept.dept_code = p.dept_code

       LEFT JOIN pat_visit@HIS pv
         ON pv.PATIENT_ID = SUBSTR(p.PATIENT_ID, 1, INSTR(p.PATIENT_ID || '_', '_') - 1)
        AND pv.VISIT_ID = p.SERIES

       LEFT JOIN DIAGNOSIS@HIS dg
         ON dg.PATIENT_ID = pv.PATIENT_ID
        AND dg.VISIT_ID = pv.VISIT_ID
        AND dg.diagnosis_type = '3'
        AND dg.diagnosis_no = '1'

       LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT TRIM(TO_CHAR(院标编码)) AS local_code,
                   MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_CHAR(国标编码)), '')) AS std_code,
                   MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_CHAR(国标名称)), '')) AS std_name
              FROM cda_dictionary@sjzx
             WHERE 字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
               AND 系统标识 = 'HIS'
               AND TRIM(TO_CHAR(院标编码)) IS NOT NULL
             GROUP BY TRIM(TO_CHAR(院标编码))
       ) diag_dict
         ON diag_dict.local_code =
            TRIM(
                REPLACE(
                    CASE
                        WHEN INSTR(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), '+') > 0
                        THEN SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), 1, INSTR(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), '+') - 1)
                        ELSE TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code)
                    END,
                    '*',
                    ''
                )
            )

 WHERE f.TEMPLATE_CODE = '709'
   AND f.is_valid = '1'
   AND f.created_by <> 'dba' AND pv.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < TO_DATE('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

SELECT
       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(f.ID), 1, 100) AS ID, -- 内码，是，唯一主键

       '49557032X' AS ORG_CODE, -- 组织机构代码，是
       '山东省第二人民医院' AS ORG_NAME, -- 组织机构名称，是

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(YDZD.mrn || '|' || YDZD.series), 1, 50) AS ADMISSION_ID, -- 住院唯一标示号，是

       SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_CHAR(dept.qmpt_code), TO_CHAR(YDZD.dept_code)), 1, 20) AS DEPT_CODE, -- 科室代码

       SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_CHAR(dept.qmpt_name), TO_CHAR(YDZD.dept_name)), 1, 50) AS DEPT_NAME, -- 科室名称，是

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(YDZD.WARD_NAME), 1, 50) AS WARD_NAME, -- 病区名称

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS EORD_NUM, -- 病房号；无可靠来源，不硬填

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(YDZD.Bed_No), 1, 10) AS SICKBED_NUM, -- 病床号

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(YDZD.NAME), 1, 50) AS NAME, -- 患者姓名，是

       CASE
           WHEN YDZD.physi_sex_name LIKE '男%' THEN '1'
           WHEN YDZD.physi_sex_name LIKE '女%' THEN '2'
           WHEN YDZD.physi_sex_name IS NULL THEN '0'
           ELSE '9'
       END AS SEX_CODE, -- 性别代码，是

       SUBSTRB(
           CASE
               WHEN YDZD.physi_sex_name LIKE '男%' THEN '男'
               WHEN YDZD.physi_sex_name LIKE '女%' THEN '女'
               WHEN YDZD.physi_sex_name IS NULL THEN '未知'
               ELSE TO_CHAR(YDZD.physi_sex_name)
           END,
           1,
           50
       ) AS SEX_NAME, -- 性别名称，是

       CASE
           WHEN YDZD.admission_time IS NOT NULL AND YDZD.birth_date IS NOT NULL
           THEN LEAST(200, GREATEST(0, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(YDZD.admission_time, YDZD.birth_date) / 12)))
           ELSE 0
       END AS AGE, -- 年龄（岁），是

       CASE
           WHEN YDZD.admission_time IS NOT NULL
                AND YDZD.birth_date IS NOT NULL
                AND TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(YDZD.admission_time, YDZD.birth_date) / 12) = 0
           THEN SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(GREATEST(0, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(YDZD.admission_time, YDZD.birth_date)))), 1, 8)
           ELSE NULL
       END AS AGE_MONTH, -- 年龄（月）

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               TO_CHAR(diag_dict.std_code),
               REPLACE(
                   CASE
                       WHEN INSTR(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), '+') > 0
                       THEN SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), 1, INSTR(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), '+') - 1)
                       ELSE TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code)
                   END,
                   '*',
                   ''
               )
           ),
           1,
           12
       ) AS DISEASE_CODE, -- 出院诊断编码，是；DIAGNOSIS@HIS + ICD字典映射

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               TO_CHAR(diag_dict.std_name),
               NVL(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_desc), NVL(TO_CHAR(YDZD.diagnosis_name), '-'))
           ),
           1,
           100
       ) AS DISEASE_NAME, -- 出院诊断描述

       TO_CHAR(p.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS DISCHARGE_DATE, -- 出院日期时间，是；取 PAT_VISIT@HIS

       NVL(
           (SELECT CASE
                       WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '^[0-9]+') = '1'
                            OR a.STRING_VALUE LIKE '%良好%'
                       THEN '1'
                       WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '^[0-9]+') = '2'
                            OR a.STRING_VALUE LIKE '%一般%'
                       THEN '2'
                       WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '^[0-9]+') = '3'
                            OR a.STRING_VALUE LIKE '%较差%'
                       THEN '3'
                       ELSE '1'
                   END
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = f.TEMPLATE_CODE
               AND a.node_code = '00021'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           '1'
       ) AS DIET_CODE, -- 饮食情况代码，是

       NVL(
           (SELECT SUBSTRB(
                       CASE
                           WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '^[0-9]+') = '1'
                                OR a.STRING_VALUE LIKE '%良好%'
                           THEN '良好'
                           WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '^[0-9]+') = '2'
                                OR a.STRING_VALUE LIKE '%一般%'
                           THEN '一般'
                           WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '^[0-9]+') = '3'
                                OR a.STRING_VALUE LIKE '%较差%'
                           THEN '较差'
                           WHEN INSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '.') > 0
                           THEN SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, INSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '.', -1) + 1)
                           ELSE a.STRING_VALUE
                       END,
                       1,
                       50
                   )
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = f.TEMPLATE_CODE
               AND a.node_code = '00021'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           '良好'
       ) AS DIET_NAME, -- 饮食情况描述，是

       NVL(
           (SELECT CASE
                       WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '^[0-9]+') = '1'
                            OR a.STRING_VALUE LIKE '%完全%'
                       THEN '1'
                       WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '^[0-9]+') = '2'
                            OR a.STRING_VALUE LIKE '%部分%'
                       THEN '2'
                       WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '^[0-9]+') = '3'
                            OR a.STRING_VALUE LIKE '%不能%'
                       THEN '3'
                       ELSE '1'
                   END
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = f.TEMPLATE_CODE
               AND a.node_code = '00020'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           '1'
       ) AS SELF_CARE_ABILITY, -- 自理能力代码，是

       NVL(
           (SELECT SUBSTRB(
                       CASE
                           WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '^[0-9]+') = '1'
                                OR a.STRING_VALUE LIKE '%完全%'
                           THEN '完全自理'
                           WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '^[0-9]+') = '2'
                                OR a.STRING_VALUE LIKE '%部分%'
                           THEN '部分自理'
                           WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '^[0-9]+') = '3'
                                OR a.STRING_VALUE LIKE '%不能%'
                           THEN '不能自理'
                           WHEN INSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '.') > 0
                           THEN SUBSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, INSTR(a.STRING_VALUE, '.', -1) + 1)
                           ELSE a.STRING_VALUE
                       END,
                       1,
                       50
                   )
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = f.TEMPLATE_CODE
               AND a.node_code = '00020'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           '完全自理'
       ) AS SELF_CARE_ABI_NA, -- 自理能力描述，是

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               (SELECT a.STRING_VALUE
                  FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
                 WHERE a.template_code = f.TEMPLATE_CODE
                   AND a.node_code = '00013'
                   AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
                   AND ROWNUM = 1),
               '-'
           ),
           1,
           2000
       ) AS DISCHARGE_SITUATION, -- 出院情况，是

             NVL(
           (SELECT CASE
                       WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE), '^[0-9]+') = '1'
                            OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%医嘱离院%'
                       THEN '1'

                       WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE), '^[0-9]+') = '2'
                            OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%医嘱转院%'
                       THEN '2'

                       WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE), '^[0-9]+') = '3'
                            OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%社区卫生服务%'
                            OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%乡镇卫生院%'
                       THEN '3'

                       WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE), '^[0-9]+') = '4'
                            OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%非医嘱离院%'
                       THEN '4'

                       WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE), '^[0-9]+') = '5'
                            OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%死亡%'
                       THEN '5'

                       WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE), '^[0-9]+') = '9'
                            OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%其他%'
                       THEN '9'

                       ELSE '9'
                   END
              FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
             WHERE a.template_code = f.TEMPLATE_CODE
               AND a.node_code = '00014'
               AND a.FORM_ID = f.ID
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           '9'
       ) AS DISCHARGE_TYPE, -- 离院方式代码：1医嘱离院 2医嘱转院 3转社区/乡镇 4非医嘱离院 5死亡 9其他

       NVL(
           (SELECT CASE
                       WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE), '^[0-9]+') = '1'
                            OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%医嘱离院%'
                       THEN '医嘱离院'

                       WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE), '^[0-9]+') = '2'
                            OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%医嘱转院%'
                       THEN '医嘱转院'

                       WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE), '^[0-9]+') = '3'
                            OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%社区卫生服务%'
                            OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%乡镇卫生院%'
                       THEN '医嘱转社区卫生服务机构/乡镇卫生院'

                       WHEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE), '^[0-9]+') = '4'
                            OR TRIM(a.STRING_VALUE) LIKE '%非医嘱离院%'
