       SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_CHAR(dept.qmpt_code), TO_CHAR(YDZD.dept_code)), 1, 20) AS DEPT_CODE, -- 科室代码

       SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_CHAR(dept.qmpt_name), TO_CHAR(YDZD.dept_name)), 1, 50) AS DEPT_NAME, -- 科室名称，是

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(YDZD.WARD_NAME), 1, 50) AS WARD_NAME, -- 病区名

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS EORD_NUM, -- 病房号；无可靠来源

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(YDZD.Bed_No), 1, 10) AS SICKBED_NUM, -- 病床号

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(YDZD.NAME), 1, 50) AS NAME, -- 患者姓名，是

       CASE
           WHEN YDZD.physi_sex_name LIKE '男%' THEN '1'
           WHEN YDZD.physi_sex_name LIKE '女%' THEN '2'
           WHEN YDZD.physi_sex_name IS NULL THEN '0'
           ELSE '9'
       END AS SEX_CODE, -- 性别代码，是

       SUBSTRB(
           CASE
               WHEN YDZD.physi_sex_name LIKE '男%' THEN '男'
               WHEN YDZD.physi_sex_name LIKE '女%' THEN '女'
               WHEN YDZD.physi_sex_name IS NULL THEN '未知'
               ELSE TO_CHAR(YDZD.physi_sex_name)
           END,
           1,
           50
       ) AS SEX_NAME, -- 性别名称，是

       CASE
           WHEN YDZD.admission_time IS NOT NULL AND YDZD.birth_date IS NOT NULL
           THEN LEAST(200, GREATEST(0, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(YDZD.admission_time, YDZD.birth_date) / 12)))
           ELSE 0
       END AS AGE, -- 年龄，是

       CASE
           WHEN YDZD.admission_time IS NOT NULL
                AND YDZD.birth_date IS NOT NULL
                AND TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(YDZD.admission_time, YDZD.birth_date) / 12) = 0
           THEN SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(GREATEST(0, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(YDZD.admission_time, YDZD.birth_date)))), 1, 2)
           ELSE NULL
       END AS AGE_MONTH, -- 年龄（月）

       NVL(
           (SELECT ROUND(A.vitalsign_nval1, 2)
              FROM mcs_vital_info A
             WHERE A.vitalsign_type = '1014'
               AND A.PATIENT_UID = YDZD.Pat_Index_No
               AND A.is_valid = '1'
               AND A.vitalsign_nval1 IS NOT NULL
               AND A.vitalsign_nval1 <> 0
               AND ROWNUM = 1),
           0
       ) AS WEIGHT, -- 体重，是

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               TO_CHAR(diag_dict.std_code),
               REPLACE(
                   CASE
                       WHEN INSTR(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), '+') > 0
                       THEN SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), 1, INSTR(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), '+') - 1)
                       ELSE NVL(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), TO_CHAR(YDZD.diagnosis_code))
                   END,
                   '*',
                   ''
               )
           ),
           1,
           12
       ) AS DISEASE_CODE, -- 疾病诊断编码

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               TO_CHAR(diag_dict.std_name),
               NVL(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_desc),
                   NVL(TO_CHAR(YDZD.diagnosis_name), '-'))
           ),
           1,
           200
       ) AS DISEASE, -- 疾病诊断名称，是

       CASE
           WHEN TO_CHAR(YDZD.nursing_class) = '0' THEN '1'
           WHEN TO_CHAR(YDZD.nursing_class) = '1' THEN '2'
           WHEN TO_CHAR(YDZD.nursing_class) = '2' THEN '3'
           WHEN TO_CHAR(YDZD.nursing_class) IN ('3', '999') THEN '4'
           ELSE '4'
       END AS NURSE_LEVEL_CODE, -- 护理等级代码：1特级护理 2一级护理 3二级护理 4三级护理

       SUBSTRB(
           CASE
               WHEN TO_CHAR(YDZD.nursing_class) = '0' THEN '特级护理'
               WHEN TO_CHAR(YDZD.nursing_class) = '1' THEN '一级护理'
               WHEN TO_CHAR(YDZD.nursing_class) = '2' THEN '二级护理'
               WHEN TO_CHAR(YDZD.nursing_class) IN ('3', '999') THEN '三级护理'
               ELSE '三级护理'
           END,
           1,
           50
       ) AS NURSE_LEVEL_NAME, -- 护理等级名称，是

       CASE
           WHEN TO_CHAR(YDZD.nursing_class) = '0' THEN '2'
           WHEN TO_CHAR(YDZD.nursing_class) IN ('1', '2', '3', '999') THEN '1'
           ELSE '9'
       END AS NURSE_TYPE_CODE, -- 护理类型代码：1基础护理 2特殊护理 3辩证施护 9其它

       SUBSTRB(
           CASE
               WHEN TO_CHAR(YDZD.nursing_class) = '0' THEN '特殊护理'
               WHEN TO_CHAR(YDZD.nursing_class) IN ('1', '2', '3', '999') THEN '基础护理'
               ELSE '其它'
           END,
           1,
           50
       ) AS NURSE_TYPE_NAME, -- 护理类型描述

       SUBSTRB(
           CASE
               WHEN WSFL.dose IS NOT NULL
               THEN '入量：' || TO_CHAR(WSFL.dose) || NVL(TO_CHAR(WSFL.dose_unit), '')
               WHEN WSFL.order_name IS NOT NULL
               THEN TO_CHAR(WSFL.order_name)
               ELSE '出入量观察'
           END,
           1,
           1000
       ) AS NURSE_OBSERVE_RESULT, -- 护理观察结果，是

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(TO_CHAR(WSFL.supply_name),
               NVL(TO_CHAR(WSFL.supply_code), '出入量记录')),
           1,
           100
       ) AS NURSE_PROJECT_NAME, -- 护理操作项目类目名称

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(TO_CHAR(WSFL.order_name),
               NVL(TO_CHAR(WSFL.supply_name), '出入量记录')),
           1,
           100
       ) AS NURSE_PROJECT, -- 护理操作名称

       SUBSTRB(
           CASE
               WHEN WSFL.dose IS NOT NULL
               THEN TO_CHAR(WSFL.dose) || NVL(TO_CHAR(WSFL.dose_unit), '')
               ELSE '已记录'
           END,
           1,
           1000
       ) AS NURSE_PROJECT_RESULT, -- 护理操作结果

       TO_CHAR(WSFL.execute_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS REPORT_DATE, -- 记录日期时间，是

       SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_CHAR(WSFL.supply_name), '-'), 1, 100) AS DRUG_USAGE, -- 药物用法

       CAST(NULL AS CHAR(1)) AS TCM_USAGE_CODE, -- 中药使用类别代码；无可靠来源，不硬填

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS TCM_USAGE_NAME, -- 中药使用类别描述；无可靠来源

           SUBSTRB(
           CASE
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(TO_CHAR(WSFL.frequence)), 'Q24H|QD|QN|QM') THEN '1'
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(TO_CHAR(WSFL.frequence)), 'Q12H|BID') THEN '2'
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(TO_CHAR(WSFL.frequence)), 'Q8H|TID') THEN '3'
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(TO_CHAR(WSFL.frequence)), 'Q6H|QID') THEN '4'
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(TO_CHAR(WSFL.frequence)), 'Q4H') THEN '6'
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(TO_CHAR(WSFL.frequence)), 'Q2H') THEN '12'
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(TO_CHAR(WSFL.frequence)), 'Q1H|QH') THEN '24'
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TO_CHAR(WSFL.frequence), '^[0-9]{1,2}$')
               THEN TO_CHAR(WSFL.frequence)
               ELSE NULL
           END,
           1,
           2
       ) AS DRUG_USAGE_RATE, -- 药物使用频率

       SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_CHAR(WSFL.dose_unit), '-'), 1, 6) AS DRUG_USAGE_MEASU, -- 药物使用计量单位

       CASE
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(REPLACE(TO_CHAR(WSFL.dose), ' ', ''), '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')
                AND TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(TO_CHAR(WSFL.dose), ' ', '')) <= 999.99
           THEN ROUND(TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(TO_CHAR(WSFL.dose), ' ', '')), 2)
           ELSE NULL
       END AS DRUG_USAGE_TIMES, -- 药物使用次计量，NUMBER(5,2)

       CASE
           WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(REPLACE(TO_CHAR(WSFL.dose), ' ', ''), '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')
           THEN ROUND(TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(TO_CHAR(WSFL.dose), ' ', '')), 2)
           ELSE NULL
       END AS DRUG_USAGE_ALL_ME, -- 药物使用总剂量，NUMBER(12,2)

       SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_CHAR(WSFL.order_name), '-'), 1, 50) AS DRUG_NAME, -- 药物名称

       '0' AS VOMIT_CODE, -- 呕吐标志：1是 0否；旧SQL为2，不符合标准

       '0' AS URESIES_DIFF_CODE, -- 排尿困难标志：1是 0否；旧SQL为2，不符合标准

       SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_CHAR(WSFL.executer_name), '-'), 1, 50) AS NURSE_NAME, -- 护士签名，是

       TO_CHAR(WSFL.execute_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS SIGNATURE_DATE, -- 签名日期，是

       '370104' AS DISTRICT_CODE, -- 行政区划，是

       'ADDHIS' AS EXCHANGE_TYPE, -- 交换类型，是

       TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS SYSTEM_TIME -- 数据上传时间，是

  FROM inpatients YDZD
       JOIN mcs_order_schedule WSFL
         ON WSFL.PATIENT_UID = YDZD.pat_index_no

       LEFT JOIN dept_dict@his dept
         ON dept.dept_code = YDZD.dept_code

       LEFT JOIN pat_visit@HIS pv
         ON pv.PATIENT_ID = SUBSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID, 1, INSTR(YDZD.PATIENT_ID || '_', '_') - 1)
        AND pv.VISIT_ID = YDZD.SERIES

       LEFT JOIN DIAGNOSIS@HIS dg
         ON dg.PATIENT_ID = pv.PATIENT_ID
        AND dg.VISIT_ID = pv.VISIT_ID
        AND dg.diagnosis_type = '3'
        AND dg.diagnosis_no = '1'

       LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT TRIM(TO_CHAR(院标编码)) AS local_code,
                   MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_CHAR(国标编码)), '')) AS std_code,
                   MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_CHAR(国标名称)), '')) AS std_name
              FROM cda_dictionary@sjzx
             WHERE 字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
               AND 系统标识 = 'HIS'
               AND TRIM(TO_CHAR(院标编码)) IS NOT NULL
             GROUP BY TRIM(TO_CHAR(院标编码))
       ) diag_dict
         ON diag_dict.local_code =
            TRIM(
                REPLACE(
                    CASE
                        WHEN INSTR(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), '+') > 0
                        THEN SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), 1, INSTR(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), '+') - 1)
                        ELSE TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code)
                    END,
                    '*',
                    ''
                )
            )

 WHERE WSFL.execute_time IS NOT NULL
   AND WSFL.Executer_Name IS NOT NULL AND pv.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < TO_DATE('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

SELECT
       SUBSTRB(
           '49557032X|' ||
           TO_CHAR(f.template_code) || '|' ||
           TO_CHAR(f.ID),
           1,
           100
       ) AS ID, -- 主键，是

       '49557032X' AS ORG_CODE, -- 医院组织机构代码，是

       '山东省第二人民医院' AS ORG_NAME, -- 医院名称，是

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(p.NAME), 1, 32) AS PAT_NAME, -- 被评估患者姓名，是

       CASE
           WHEN p.physi_sex_name LIKE '男%' THEN '1'
           WHEN p.physi_sex_name LIKE '女%' THEN '2'
           WHEN p.physi_sex_name IS NULL THEN '0'
           ELSE '9'
       END AS PAT_SEX, -- 被评估患者性别，是

       '2' AS PAT_TYPE_CODE, -- 被评估患者类别：1门诊 2住院，是

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(p.mrn || '|' || p.series), 1, 32) AS VISITING_NUM, -- 被评估病人就诊号，是

       SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_CHAR(dept.qmpt_code), TO_CHAR(p.dept_code)), 1, 12) AS DEPT_ID, -- 患者所在科室编码，是

       SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_CHAR(dept.qmpt_name), TO_CHAR(p.dept_name)), 1, 50) AS DEPT_NAME, -- 患者所在科室名称，是

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(32)) AS APPLY_DOC_NAME, -- 医生姓名；护理量表暂无可靠来源

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(18)) AS APPLY_DOC_ID, -- 医生身份证号码；暂无可靠来源

       SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_CHAR(f.created_name), TO_CHAR(f.last_updated_name)), 1, 32) AS NURSE_NAME, -- 护士姓名

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(18)) AS NURSE_ID_NUM, -- 护士身份证号；暂无可靠来源，不用工号冒充

       TO_CHAR(f.created_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS CREATE_TIME, -- 评估时间，是

       SUBSTRB(
           CASE
               WHEN f.template_code = '564' THEN '改良 Barthel 指数评分表'
               WHEN f.template_code IN ('616', '619') THEN '成人NRS 2002营养风险筛查表'
               WHEN f.template_code = '782' THEN '儿童STAMP量表'
               WHEN f.template_code = '854' THEN 'PG-SGA营养评估量表'
               WHEN f.template_code = '722' THEN '数字评分量表（NRS）'
               WHEN f.template_code = '598' THEN '格拉斯哥昏迷量表（GCS）'
               ELSE '其他量表'
           END,
           1,
           200
       ) AS SCALE_NAME, -- 评估量表名称，是

       SUBSTRB(
           CASE
               WHEN f.template_code = '564' THEN '30'
               WHEN f.template_code IN ('616', '619') THEN '48'
               WHEN f.template_code = '782' THEN '49'
               WHEN f.template_code = '854' THEN '52'
               WHEN f.template_code = '722' THEN '62'
               WHEN f.template_code = '598' THEN '80'
               ELSE '99'
           END,
           1,
           100
       ) AS SCALE_CODE, -- 评估量表编码，是

       ROUND(score.score_val, 2) AS SCORE_VAL, -- 评分数值，是；按确认后的总分节点取值

       SUBSTRB(
           CASE
               /* 30 改良 Barthel 指数评分表：分值越低风险越高 */
               WHEN f.template_code = '564' THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN score.score_val <= 40 THEN '高危'
                        WHEN score.score_val <= 60 THEN '中危'
                        ELSE '低危'
                    END

               /* 48 成人NRS 2002营养风险筛查表：NRS2002得分 >=3 为营养风险 */
               WHEN f.template_code IN ('616', '619') THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN score.score_val >= 3 THEN '高危'
                        WHEN score.score_val = 2 THEN '中危'
                        ELSE '低危'
                    END

               /* 49 儿童STAMP量表：0-1低危，2-3中危，>=4高危 */
               WHEN f.template_code = '782' THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN score.score_val >= 4 THEN '高危'
                        WHEN score.score_val >= 2 THEN '中危'
                        ELSE '低危'
                    END

               /* 52 PG-SGA营养评估量表：A+B+C+D总分，0-1低危，2-8中危，>=9高危 */
               WHEN f.template_code = '854' THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN score.score_val >= 9 THEN '高危'
                        WHEN score.score_val >= 2 THEN '中危'
                        ELSE '低危'
                    END

               /* 62 数字评分量表（NRS）：0-3低危，4-6中危，7-10高危 */
               WHEN f.template_code = '722' THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN score.score_val >= 7 THEN '高危'
                        WHEN score.score_val >= 4 THEN '中危'
                        ELSE '低危'
                    END

               /* 80 格拉斯哥昏迷量表（GCS）：分值越低风险越高 */
               WHEN f.template_code = '598' THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN score.score_val <= 8 THEN '高危'
                        WHEN score.score_val <= 12 THEN '中危'
                        ELSE '低危'
                    END

               ELSE '低危'
           END,
           1,
           10
       ) AS GRADE_LVL, -- 评估等级，是：低危、中危、高危

       'ADDHIS' AS EXCHANGE_TYPE, -- 交换类型，是

       TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS SYSTEM_TIME -- 数据上传/更新时间，是

  FROM mcs_doc_form f

       JOIN inpatients p
         ON f.PATIENT_UID = p.pat_index_no

       LEFT JOIN dept_dict@his dept
         ON dept.dept_code = p.dept_code

       JOIN pat_visit@HIS pv
         ON pv.PATIENT_ID = SUBSTR(p.PATIENT_ID, 1, INSTR(p.PATIENT_ID || '_', '_') - 1)
        AND pv.VISIT_ID = p.SERIES

       JOIN (
            SELECT r.form_id,
                   r.template_code,

                   CASE
                       WHEN r.template_code = '564' THEN
                            MAX(CASE WHEN r.node_code = '00083' THEN r.score_val END) -- Barthel总分

                       WHEN r.template_code = '598' THEN
                            MAX(CASE WHEN r.node_code = '00020' THEN r.score_val END) -- GCS总分

                       WHEN r.template_code = '616' THEN
                            MAX(CASE WHEN r.node_code = '00043' THEN r.score_val END) -- NRS2002得分

                       WHEN r.template_code = '619' THEN
                            MAX(CASE WHEN r.node_code = '00028' THEN r.score_val END) -- 旧NRS2002总分

                       WHEN r.template_code = '722' THEN
                            MAX(CASE WHEN r.node_code = '00140' THEN r.score_val END) -- 疼痛评估总分

                       WHEN r.template_code = '782' THEN
                            MAX(CASE WHEN r.node_code = '00027' THEN r.score_val END) -- 儿童营养风险总分

                       WHEN r.template_code = '854' THEN
                            MAX(CASE WHEN r.node_code = '00159' THEN r.score_val END) -- PG-SGA A+B+C+D总分

                       ELSE NULL
                   END AS score_val

              FROM (
                    SELECT a.form_id,
                           a.template_code,
                           a.node_code,
                           CASE
                               WHEN a.number_value IS NOT NULL
                               THEN a.number_value

                               WHEN a.string_value IS NOT NULL
                                    AND REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(TO_CHAR(a.string_value)), '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')
                               THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(TO_CHAR(a.string_value)))

                               ELSE NULL
                           END AS score_val
                      FROM mcs_doc_form_records a
                     WHERE a.template_code IN ('564', '616', '619', '782', '854', '722', '598')
                       AND (
                              (a.template_code = '564' AND a.node_code = '00083') -- Barthel总分
                           OR (a.template_code = '598' AND a.node_code = '00020') -- GCS总分
                           OR (a.template_code = '616' AND a.node_code = '00043') -- NRS2002得分
                           OR (a.template_code = '619' AND a.node_code = '00028') -- 旧NRS2002总分
                           OR (a.template_code = '722' AND a.node_code = '00140') -- 疼痛总分
                           OR (a.template_code = '782' AND a.node_code = '00027') -- 儿童营养风险总分
                           OR (a.template_code = '854' AND a.node_code = '00159') -- PG-SGA A+B+C+D总分
                           )
                   ) r
             GROUP BY r.form_id,
                      r.template_code
            HAVING CASE
                       WHEN r.template_code = '564' THEN
                            MAX(CASE WHEN r.node_code = '00083' THEN r.score_val END)
                       WHEN r.template_code = '598' THEN
                            MAX(CASE WHEN r.node_code = '00020' THEN r.score_val END)
                       WHEN r.template_code = '616' THEN
                            MAX(CASE WHEN r.node_code = '00043' THEN r.score_val END)
                       WHEN r.template_code = '619' THEN
                            MAX(CASE WHEN r.node_code = '00028' THEN r.score_val END)
                       WHEN r.template_code = '722' THEN
                            MAX(CASE WHEN r.node_code = '00140' THEN r.score_val END)
                       WHEN r.template_code = '782' THEN
                            MAX(CASE WHEN r.node_code = '00027' THEN r.score_val END)
                       WHEN r.template_code = '854' THEN
                            MAX(CASE WHEN r.node_code = '00159' THEN r.score_val END)
                       ELSE NULL
                   END IS NOT NULL
       ) score
         ON score.form_id = f.ID
        AND score.template_code = f.template_code

 WHERE f.template_code IN ('564', '616', '619', '782', '854', '722', '598')
   AND f.is_valid = '1'
   AND f.created_by <> 'dba'
   AND p.status = 'out'
   AND pv.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME >= TO_DATE('2021-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
   AND pv.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME <  TO_DATE('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

SELECT
       SUBSTRB(
           '49557032X|' ||
           TO_CHAR(p.mrn) || '|' ||
           TO_CHAR(p.series) || '|' ||
           TO_CHAR(wsfl.plan_time, 'yyyymmddhh24miss') || '|' ||
           NVL(TO_CHAR(wsfl.ward_code), '-'),
           1,
           100
       ) AS ID, -- 内码，是，唯一主键

       '49557032X' AS ORG_CODE, -- 组织机构代码，是

       '山东省第二人民医院' AS ORG_NAME, -- 组织机构名称，是

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(p.mrn || '|' || p.series), 1, 50) AS ADMISSION_ID, -- 住院唯一标示号，是

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(p.dept_code), 1, 20) AS DEPT_CODE, -- 科室代码

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(p.dept_name), 1, 50) AS DEPT_NAME, -- 科室名称，是

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(p.ward_name), 1, 50) AS WARD_NAME, -- 病区名称

       CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(10)) AS EORD_NUM, -- 病房号；无可靠来源

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(p.bed_no), 1, 10) AS SICKBED_NUM, -- 病床号

       SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(p.name), 1, 50) AS NAME, -- 患者姓名，是

       CASE
           WHEN p.physi_sex_name LIKE '男%' THEN '1'
           WHEN p.physi_sex_name LIKE '女%' THEN '2'
           WHEN p.physi_sex_name IS NULL THEN '0'
           ELSE '9'
       END AS SEX_CODE, -- 性别代码，是

       SUBSTRB(
           CASE
               WHEN p.physi_sex_name LIKE '男%' THEN '男'
               WHEN p.physi_sex_name LIKE '女%' THEN '女'
               WHEN p.physi_sex_name IS NULL THEN '未知'
               ELSE TO_CHAR(p.physi_sex_name)
           END,
           1,
           50
       ) AS SEX_NAME, -- 性别名称，是

       CASE
           WHEN p.admission_time IS NOT NULL AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
           THEN LEAST(200, GREATEST(0, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(p.admission_time, p.birth_date) / 12)))
           ELSE 0
       END AS AGE, -- 年龄，是

       CASE
           WHEN p.admission_time IS NOT NULL
                AND p.birth_date IS NOT NULL
                AND TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(p.admission_time, p.birth_date) / 12) = 0
           THEN SUBSTRB(TO_CHAR(GREATEST(0, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(p.admission_time, p.birth_date)))), 1, 8)
           ELSE NULL
       END AS AGE_MONTH, -- 年龄（月）

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               TO_CHAR(diag_dict.std_code),
               REPLACE(
                   CASE
                       WHEN INSTR(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), '+') > 0
                       THEN SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), 1, INSTR(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), '+') - 1)
                       ELSE NVL(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code), TO_CHAR(p.diagnosis_code))
                   END,
                   '*',
                   ''
               )
           ),
           1,
           12
       ) AS DISEASE_CODE, -- 疾病诊断编码，优先取HIS出院主诊断

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               TO_CHAR(diag_dict.std_name),
               NVL(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_desc), NVL(TO_CHAR(p.diagnosis_name), '-'))
           ),
           1,
           50
       ) AS DISEASE_NAME, -- 疾病诊断，是

       TO_CHAR(p.admission_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS ADMISSION_DATE, -- 入院日期时间，是

       CASE
           WHEN wsfl.plan_time IS NOT NULL AND p.admission_time IS NOT NULL
           THEN GREATEST(0, TRUNC(wsfl.plan_time - p.admission_time) + 1)
           ELSE 0
       END AS INPATIENT_DAY, -- 实际住院天数，是

       CASE
           WHEN op.begin_time IS NOT NULL
                AND wsfl.plan_time IS NOT NULL
                AND wsfl.plan_time >= op.begin_time
           THEN GREATEST(0, TRUNC(wsfl.plan_time - op.begin_time) + 1)
           ELSE 0
       END AS OPERATION_DAY, -- 手术或分娩后天数

       TO_CHAR(wsfl.plan_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS RECORD_DATE, -- 记录日期时间，是

       NVL(ROUND(wsfl.breathing_rate), 0) AS BREATHING_RATE, -- 呼吸频率，是

       CASE
           WHEN NVL(wsfl.breathing_machine_flag, 0) > 0 THEN '1'
           ELSE '0'
       END AS BREATHING_MACHINE_CODE, -- 使用呼吸机标志：1是 0否，是

       NVL(ROUND(wsfl.pulse_rate), 0) AS PULSE_RATE, -- 脉率，是

       NVL(ROUND(wsfl.heart_rate), 0) AS HEART_RATE, -- 心率，来源1003

       NVL(ROUND(wsfl.temperature, 1), 0) AS TEMPERATURE, -- 体温，是

       NVL(ROUND(wsfl.pressure_h), 0) AS PRESSURE_H, -- 收缩压，是

       NVL(ROUND(wsfl.pressure_l), 0) AS PRESSURE_L, -- 舒张压，是

       NVL(ROUND(wsfl.weight, 2), 0) AS WEIGHT, -- 体重，是

       ROUND(wsfl.abdominal, 1) AS ABDOMINAL, -- 腹围

       '生命体征监测' AS ODSERVE_NAME, -- 护理观察项目名称，是

       SUBSTRB(
           NVL(
               NULLIF(
                   LTRIM(
                       CASE
                           WHEN NVL(wsfl.temperature, 0) <> 0
                           THEN '，体温' || TO_CHAR(ROUND(wsfl.temperature, 1)) || '℃'
                           ELSE ''
                       END ||
                       CASE
                           WHEN NVL(wsfl.pulse_rate, 0) <> 0
                           THEN '，脉搏' || TO_CHAR(ROUND(wsfl.pulse_rate)) || '次/分'
                           ELSE ''
                       END ||
                       CASE
                           WHEN NVL(wsfl.heart_rate, 0) <> 0
                           THEN '，心率' || TO_CHAR(ROUND(wsfl.heart_rate)) || '次/分'
                           ELSE ''
                       END ||
                       CASE
                           WHEN NVL(wsfl.breathing_rate, 0) <> 0
                           THEN '，呼吸' || TO_CHAR(ROUND(wsfl.breathing_rate)) || '次/分'
                           ELSE ''
                       END ||
                       CASE
                           WHEN NVL(wsfl.pressure_h, 0) <> 0
                                OR NVL(wsfl.pressure_l, 0) <> 0
                           THEN '，血压' || TO_CHAR(NVL(ROUND(wsfl.pressure_h), 0)) || '/'
                                          || TO_CHAR(NVL(ROUND(wsfl.pressure_l), 0)) || 'mmHg'
                           ELSE ''
                       END ||
                       CASE
                           WHEN NVL(wsfl.oxygen_saturation, 0) <> 0
                           THEN '，血氧饱和度' || TO_CHAR(ROUND(wsfl.oxygen_saturation, 1)) || '%'
                           ELSE ''
                       END ||
                       CASE
                           WHEN NVL(wsfl.weight, 0) <> 0
                           THEN '，体重' || TO_CHAR(ROUND(wsfl.weight, 2)) || 'kg'
                           ELSE ''
                       END ||
                       CASE
                           WHEN NVL(wsfl.abdominal, 0) <> 0
                           THEN '，腹围' || TO_CHAR(ROUND(wsfl.abdominal, 1)) || 'cm'
                           ELSE ''
                       END,
                       '，'
                   ),
                   ''
               ),
               '生命体征已记录'
           ),
           1,
           1000
       ) AS ODSERVE_RESULT, -- 护理观察结果，是

       SUBSTRB(NVL(TO_CHAR(us.user_name), TO_CHAR(wsfl.created_by)), 1, 50) AS NURSE_NAME, -- 护士签名，是

       TO_CHAR(wsfl.record_time, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS RECORD_DATE2, -- 签名日期时间，是

       '370104' AS DISTRICT_CODE, -- 行政区划，是

       'ADDHIS' AS EXCHANGE_TYPE, -- 交换类型，是

       TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS SYSTEM_TIME -- 数据上传时间，是

  FROM inpatients p

       JOIN (
            SELECT aa.patient_uid,
                   aa.ward_code,
                   aa.plan_time,
                   MIN(aa.record_time) AS record_time,
                   MIN(aa.record_nurse_id) AS created_by,

                   MAX(CASE WHEN aa.vitalsign_type = '1004' THEN aa.vitalsign_nval1 END) AS breathing_rate, -- 呼吸

                   MAX(CASE
                           WHEN aa.vitalsign_type = '1004'
                                AND aa.vitalsign_sval2 IS NOT NULL
                           THEN 1
                           ELSE 0
                       END) AS breathing_machine_flag, -- 呼吸机标志

                   MAX(CASE WHEN aa.vitalsign_type = '1002' THEN aa.vitalsign_nval1 END) AS pulse_rate, -- 脉搏

                   MAX(CASE WHEN aa.vitalsign_type = '1003' THEN aa.vitalsign_nval1 END) AS heart_rate, -- 心率

                   MAX(CASE WHEN aa.vitalsign_type = '1001' THEN aa.vitalsign_nval1 END) AS temperature, -- 体温

                   COALESCE(
                       MAX(CASE WHEN aa.vitalsign_type = '1005' THEN aa.vitalsign_nval1 END),
                       MAX(CASE WHEN aa.vitalsign_type = '3009' THEN aa.vitalsign_nval1 END),
                       MAX(CASE WHEN aa.vitalsign_type = '3010' THEN aa.vitalsign_nval1 END)
                   ) AS pressure_h, -- 收缩压

                   COALESCE(
                       MAX(CASE WHEN aa.vitalsign_type = '1005' THEN aa.vitalsign_nval2 END),
                       MAX(CASE WHEN aa.vitalsign_type = '3009' THEN aa.vitalsign_nval2 END),
                       MAX(CASE WHEN aa.vitalsign_type = '3010' THEN aa.vitalsign_nval2 END)
                   ) AS pressure_l, -- 舒张压

                   MAX(CASE WHEN aa.vitalsign_type = '1006' THEN aa.vitalsign_nval1 END) AS oxygen_saturation, -- 血氧饱和度

                   MAX(CASE WHEN aa.vitalsign_type = '1014' THEN aa.vitalsign_nval1 END) AS weight, -- 体重

                   MAX(CASE WHEN aa.vitalsign_type = '1013' THEN aa.vitalsign_nval1 END) AS height, -- 身高，备用

                   MAX(CASE WHEN aa.vitalsign_type = '3080' THEN aa.vitalsign_nval1 END) AS abdominal, -- 腹围，旧逻辑保留

                   COALESCE(
                       MAX(CASE WHEN aa.vitalsign_type = '1010' THEN aa.vitalsign_nval1 END),
                       MAX(CASE WHEN aa.vitalsign_type IN ('1008', '3007') THEN aa.vitalsign_nval1 END),
                       MAX(CASE WHEN aa.vitalsign_type IN ('3008', '3002', '3003', '3004', '3005', '3006', '3011', '3012', '3013') THEN aa.vitalsign_nval1 END)
                   ) AS output_amount, -- 出量相关，备用

                   COALESCE(
                       MAX(CASE WHEN aa.vitalsign_type = '1009' THEN aa.vitalsign_nval1 END),
                       MAX(CASE WHEN aa.vitalsign_type IN ('1032', '1033') THEN aa.vitalsign_nval1 END)
                   ) AS input_amount -- 入量相关，备用

              FROM mcs_vital_info aa
             WHERE aa.is_valid = '1'
               AND aa.plan_time IS NOT NULL
               AND aa.vitalsign_type IN (
                   '1001', -- 体温
                   '1002', -- 脉搏
                   '1003', -- 心率
                   '1004', -- 呼吸
                   '1005', -- 血压
                   '3009', -- 血压
                   '3010', -- 血压
                   '1006', -- 血氧饱和度
                   '1014', -- 体重
                   '1013', -- 身高
                   '3080', -- 腹围，旧逻辑保留
                   '1010', -- 出量
                   '1009', -- 入量
                   '1008', -- 尿量
                   '3007', -- 尿量
                   '3008', -- 引流量
                   '3002', -- 胃管引流
                   '3003', -- 胸腔引流
                   '3004', -- 腹腔引流
                   '3005', -- 导管
                   '3006', -- T管
                   '3011', -- 皮下引流
                   '3012', -- 腹壁引流
                   '3013', -- 宫腔引流
                   '1032', -- 母乳
                   '1033'  -- 牛乳
               )
             GROUP BY aa.patient_uid,
                      aa.ward_code,
                      aa.plan_time
            HAVING MAX(
                       CASE
                           WHEN aa.vitalsign_type IN ('1001', '1002', '1003', '1004', '1005', '3009', '3010', '1014', '3080')
                                AND (
                                      NVL(aa.vitalsign_nval1, 0) <> 0
                                   OR NVL(aa.vitalsign_nval2, 0) <> 0
                                   OR aa.vitalsign_sval2 IS NOT NULL
                                )
                           THEN 1
                           ELSE 0
                       END
                   ) = 1
       ) wsfl
         ON wsfl.patient_uid = p.pat_index_no

       LEFT JOIN mcs_sys_users us
         ON wsfl.created_by = us.user_code

       LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT e.patient_uid,
                   MIN(e.begin_time) AS begin_time
              FROM mcs_event_info e
             WHERE e.event_type IN ('2003', '2004')
             GROUP BY e.patient_uid
       ) op
         ON op.patient_uid = wsfl.patient_uid

       JOIN pat_visit@HIS pv
         ON pv.PATIENT_ID = SUBSTR(p.PATIENT_ID, 1, INSTR(p.PATIENT_ID || '_', '_') - 1)
        AND pv.VISIT_ID = p.SERIES

       LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT d.PATIENT_ID,
                   d.VISIT_ID,
                   MAX(
                       REPLACE(
                           CASE
                               WHEN INSTR(TO_CHAR(d.diagnosis_code), '+') > 0
                               THEN SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(d.diagnosis_code), 1, INSTR(TO_CHAR(d.diagnosis_code), '+') - 1)
                               ELSE TO_CHAR(d.diagnosis_code)
                           END,
                           '*',
                           ''
                       )
                   ) AS diagnosis_code,
                   MAX(TO_CHAR(d.diagnosis_desc)) AS diagnosis_desc
              FROM DIAGNOSIS@HIS d
             WHERE d.diagnosis_type = '3'
               AND d.diagnosis_no = '1'
             GROUP BY d.PATIENT_ID,
                      d.VISIT_ID
       ) dg
         ON dg.PATIENT_ID = pv.PATIENT_ID
        AND dg.VISIT_ID = pv.VISIT_ID

       LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT TRIM(TO_CHAR(院标编码)) AS local_code,
                   MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_CHAR(国标编码)), '')) AS std_code,
                   MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(TO_CHAR(国标名称)), '')) AS std_name
              FROM cda_dictionary@sjzx
             WHERE 字典名称 = 'ICD-10诊断编码'
               AND 系统标识 = 'HIS'
               AND TRIM(TO_CHAR(院标编码)) IS NOT NULL
             GROUP BY TRIM(TO_CHAR(院标编码))
       ) diag_dict
         ON diag_dict.local_code = TRIM(TO_CHAR(dg.diagnosis_code))

 WHERE p.status = 'out'
   AND pv.DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < TO_DATE('2025-01-01 00:00:00', 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')

SELECT
    base.患者ID,
    base.患者UID,
    base.床号,
    base.FORM_ID,
    base.日期时间,
    base.记录人,
    base.创建时间,
    base.TEMPLATE_CODE,
    -- ★ 护理单类型标识
    CASE base.TEMPLATE_CODE
        WHEN '572' THEN '一般患者护理记录单'
        WHEN '709' THEN '病重（病危）患者护理记录'
        ELSE '其他'
    END                                                         AS 护理单类型,

    -- ① 基本信息（572/709 字段不同，用 COALESCE 合并）
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00021' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00002' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 姓名,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00022' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00003' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 性别,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00023' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00004' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 年龄,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00018' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00005' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 科室,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00019' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00006' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 床号_填写,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00020' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00007' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 住院号,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00024' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00009' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 诊断,
    MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00140' THEN base.VALUE END)
                                                                AS 入院日期,

    -- ② 生命体征（572/709 CODE 不同）
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00172' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00022' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 体温,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00174' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00023' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 心率脉搏,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00122' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00024' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 呼吸,
    -- 血压：572用收缩压/舒张压拼接，709直接一个字段
    COALESCE(
        -- 572 血压拼接
        CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' THEN
            MAX(CASE WHEN base.CODE='00117' THEN base.VALUE END)
            || CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN base.CODE='00117' THEN base.VALUE END) IS NOT NULL
                    AND  MAX(CASE WHEN base.CODE='00119' THEN base.VALUE END) IS NOT NULL
                    THEN ' / ' ELSE NULL END
            || MAX(CASE WHEN base.CODE='00119' THEN base.VALUE END)
        END,
        -- 709 血压直接取
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00028' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 血压,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00120' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00029' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 血氧饱和度,
    -- 血糖（仅709有）
    MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00172' THEN base.VALUE END)
                                                                AS 血糖,

    -- ③ 意识/神志
    -- 572：子节点勾选；709：直接文本值
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572'
                 AND base.PARENT_CODE='00038'
                 AND base.NUMBER_VALUE=1
                 THEN base.DISPLAY_NAME END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00142' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 意识神志,

    -- ④ 氧疗
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00133' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00143' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 氧疗_鼻导管,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00134' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00144' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 氧疗_面罩,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00132' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00145' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 氧疗_其他名称,
    MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00161' THEN base.VALUE END)
                                                                AS 氧疗_其他量,

    -- ⑤ 入量（572/709 字段不同）
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00084' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00148' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 入量_名称,
    -- 709 特有：入量途径
    MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00171' THEN base.VALUE END)
                                                                AS 入量_途径,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00085' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00149' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 入量_量,
    MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00086' THEN base.VALUE END)
                                                                AS 入量_量2,

    -- ⑥ 出量（572/709 字段不同）
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00088' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00150' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 出量_名称,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00089' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00151' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 出量_量,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00090' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00152' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 出量_颜色,
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00091' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00166' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 出量_性状,
    -- 572 特有
    MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00162' THEN base.VALUE END)
                                                                AS 尿量,
    MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00164' THEN base.VALUE END)
                                                                AS 呕吐,

    -- ⑦ 刀口情况（572 特有，多选去重）
    LISTAGG(
        CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572'
             AND base.PARENT_CODE='00143'
             AND base.NUMBER_VALUE=1
             AND base.RN=1
             THEN base.DISPLAY_NAME END
    , '，') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY base.SEQ)                   AS 刀口情况,

    -- ⑧ 管道护理（572 特有）
    MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00148' THEN base.VALUE END)
                                                                AS 管道护理,

    -- ⑨ 皮肤情况（572 特有，多选去重）
    LISTAGG(
        CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572'
             AND base.PARENT_CODE='00149'
             AND base.NUMBER_VALUE=1
             AND base.RN=1
             THEN base.DISPLAY_NAME END
    , '，') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY base.SEQ)                   AS 皮肤情况,

    -- ⑩ 皮肤护理（572 特有，多选去重）
    LISTAGG(
        CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572'
             AND base.PARENT_CODE='00155'
             AND base.NUMBER_VALUE=1
             AND base.RN=1
             THEN base.DISPLAY_NAME END
    , '，') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY base.SEQ)                   AS 皮肤护理,

    -- ? 高危风险（572 特有，多选去重）
    LISTAGG(
        CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572'
             AND base.PARENT_CODE='00073'
             AND base.NUMBER_VALUE=1
             AND base.RN=1
             THEN base.DISPLAY_NAME END
    , '，') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY base.SEQ)                   AS 高危风险,

    -- ? 病情记录/病情观察及护理措施
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00093' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00153' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 病情观察及护理措施,

    -- ? 护士签名
    COALESCE(
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='572' AND base.CODE='00094' THEN base.VALUE END),
        MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00062' THEN base.VALUE END)
    )                                                           AS 护士签名,

    -- ? 审核者签名（709 特有）
    MAX(CASE WHEN base.TEMPLATE_CODE='709' AND base.CODE='00169' THEN base.VALUE END)
                                                                AS 审核者签名

FROM (
    SELECT
        d.patient_id                AS 患者ID,
        a.PATIENT_UID               AS 患者UID,
        a.BED_NO                    AS 床号,
        a.FORM_TIME                 AS 日期时间,
        a.CREATED_NAME              AS 记录人,
        a.CREATED_DATE              AS 创建时间,
        a.ID                        AS FORM_ID,
        e.TEMPLATE_CODE,
        e.CODE,
        e.PARENT_CODE,
        e.SEQ,
        e.NODE_LEVEL,
        e.IS_LEAF,
        e.DISPLAY_NAME,
        c.STRING_VALUE,
        c.NUMBER_VALUE,
        CASE
            WHEN c.STRING_VALUE IS NOT NULL
                THEN c.STRING_VALUE
            WHEN c.NUMBER_VALUE = 1 AND e.IS_LEAF = 1
                THEN e.DISPLAY_NAME
            WHEN c.NUMBER_VALUE IS NOT NULL
                THEN TRIM(TO_CHAR(c.NUMBER_VALUE, 'FM99999999990.099'))
            ELSE NULL
        END                         AS VALUE,
        -- 按 FORM_ID + CODE 去重，取层级最浅的一条
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY a.ID, e.CODE
            ORDER BY e.NODE_LEVEL
        )                           AS RN
    FROM
        inpatients d
        INNER JOIN mcs_doc_form a
            ON d.pat_index_no = a.PATIENT_UID
        LEFT JOIN mcs_doc_form_records c
            ON a.ID = c.FORM_ID
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT
                t.TEMPLATE_CODE,
                t.CODE,
                t.PARENT_CODE,
                t.SEQ,
                NVL(t.DISPLAY_NAME, t.NAME)                              AS DISPLAY_NAME,
                SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(t.CODE, '|')                         AS CODE_PATH,
                SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(
                    REPLACE(TRIM(NVL(t.DISPLAY_NAME, t.NAME)), '|', '-')
                , '|')                                                    AS NAME_PATH,
                LEVEL                                                     AS NODE_LEVEL,
                CONNECT_BY_ISLEAF                                         AS IS_LEAF
            FROM MCS_DOC_NODES t
            WHERE t.TEMPLATE_CODE IN ('572', '709')
            START WITH
                t.PARENT_CODE IS NULL
                AND t.TEMPLATE_CODE IN ('572', '709')
            CONNECT BY
                PRIOR t.CODE = t.PARENT_CODE
                AND t.TEMPLATE_CODE IN ('572', '709')
        ) e
            ON  e.TEMPLATE_CODE = c.TEMPLATE_CODE
            AND e.CODE          = c.NODE_CODE
    WHERE
        d.STATUS        = 'in'
        AND d.DEPT_CODE IN ('030210', '020103') --and d.name ='马祥兰'
        AND a.FORM_TIME >= TO_DATE('2026-03-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd')
        AND a.IS_VALID  = '1'
        AND (
            c.STRING_VALUE IS NOT NULL
            OR c.NUMBER_VALUE IS NOT NULL
        )
) base
WHERE base.RN = 1
GROUP BY
    base.患者ID,
    base.患者UID,
    base.床号,
    base.FORM_ID,
    base.日期时间,
    base.记录人,
    base.创建时间,
    base.TEMPLATE_CODE
ORDER BY
    base.日期时间
